prs.title: Go public, protection live, note dumps scrubbed
prs.summary: The repository became public and branch protection went live on `main`, verified by read-back: eight required checks, zero required approvals, enforce-for-admins on, force-pushes and deletion blocked, so direct pushes are refused for everyone including maintainers (DECISIONS.md, 2026-08-11 — public, and branch protection live). `FLIP_RUNBOOK.md`, which sequenced the flip, was retired. The DCO gate was repaired: it had counted GitHub's synthetic merge commit, which no one can sign, and would have failed every pull request; the fix is `--no-merges`. The deference note dump received its first scrub — two cuts, both candid assessments of a named colleague — with frozen digests recomputed and `frozen/MANIFEST.md` annotated; four judgment calls went the other way and were recorded so they could be reversed. The round wrote no report of its own; `prompts/2026-08-11-public-flip-and-scrub/REPORT.md` is a reconstruction from the pull request and commits, and says the bundles were public before the scrub ran, that removal at HEAD is not erasure from history, and that the release gate for the dumps was undischarged at the flip by the maintainer's decision.
prs.superseded: Two of the four kept judgment calls were reversed by PR #2. `SCRUB_REPORT.md` was later removed from the repository root (DECISIONS.md, 2026-08-11 — the setup and scrub reports are removed from the root), and the `frozen/` manifest-and-digest procedure this scrub went through was retired by PR #9 (2026-08-11 — `frozen/` retired; received work becomes line content); the scrubbed dump now lives at `projects/deference/note-dump-2026-06-27/` with an `ORIGIN.md` receipt.

prs.title: Contributor-supplied checkers and the contributor-checked class
prs.summary: The epistemic class ordering gains `contributor-checked`, below the house-checked classes and above `test-supported`, for a claim certified by a checker that ships with the contribution under `checkers/contrib/` rather than by the house harness. The rule that contributors never ship verifiers was replaced by the asymmetry it stood for: modifying a house checker is retroactive (every claim it already certified re-inherits the change) and stays gated; adding a checker for a new claim is prospective and contained and is labelled instead. The cap is mechanical — `checkers/registry.py` derives the ceiling from the invocation path, so a `contrib/` checker declared at a higher class fails, and a house checker declared `contributor-checked` also fails; the three cases are permanent self-test cases (six to nine). `checkers/contrib/` is proof layer, which required the path gate to give proof patterns precedence over specification patterns, since the directory sits inside `checkers/`. `tests/contrib_hygiene.py` requires stdlib-only imports, a module docstring and a top-level `check` function. Two promotion paths out of the class are stated (maintainer reads the checker and it becomes house; or the claim is ported to Lean), with the standing guidance that new verification logic goes to Lean where it can. No existing registry entry changed class. Reserved with a proposed answer: whether a `contributor-checked` claim may satisfy an acceptance criterion (proposed yes by default, the item free to say otherwise).
prs.state_after: The contribution model now has a place for verification logic written by contributors. A claim certified by a checker that ships with its contribution enters the record as contributor-checked, a class below anything the house harness adjudicates and above merely test-supported; the cap is derived mechanically from where the checker lives, so declaring a higher class fails. The reasoning is an asymmetry: changing a house checker silently re-judges every claim it already certified, while adding one for a new claim affects only that claim. The standing guidance is that new verification logic goes to Lean wherever it can, since the kernel is a judge nobody has to read. The research lines are unchanged, with the deference corpus ready and nothing registered.

prs.title: PRIORITIES, and slop discipline as a standard
prs.summary: `OPEN_PROBLEMS.md` became `PRIORITIES.md`, reframed as the maintainer's ranking of what would move the work rather than an inventory of what is unsolved (DECISIONS.md, 2026-08-11 — the contribution funnel is `PRIORITIES.md`); fifteen references in eleven files were updated. Both a missing file and an empty item set are now hard failures, with two permanent self-test cases (harness nine to eleven). Slop discipline entered AGENTS.md as a seven-rule standard and grounds for rejection on its own (2026-08-11 — slop discipline is a standard, and grounds for rejection); the application pass over README, CONTRIBUTING, AGENTS and PRIORITIES net-added lines, because it found more stale facts than padding — the gate table said six gates where eight ran, and CONTRIBUTING listed five commands. prs.state_after: The maintainer's ranking of what would move the work replaces the inventory of what is unsolved: the priorities file is the funnel through which research enters, and nothing reaches the claims registry except in answer to an item on it. prs.title: Recover the priorities round; a null-input case for every gate
prs.summary: Two results. First, the priorities round (PR #7) had been merged into `patch/attribution-provenance-names` three minutes after that branch squash-merged to `main`, so GitHub marked it merged while `main` still had `OPEN_PROBLEMS.md`; it was recovered by cherry-pick, and the resulting tree is byte-identical to the original branch. Four gates had real holes: `path_gate` and `dco` returned 0 on an empty diff inside a pull request, where an empty diff means the fetch failed; `conservativity` wrote a missing `spec_shape.json` and passed, so deleting the baseline silently re-froze the shape, now a failure with `--record` as the deliberate path; and `check_frozen` verified a registry with zero entries. Also: `tests/run.py` had never invoked `conservativity.py` at all, now wired in with a coverage check; the ledger was settled as append-only in substance (2026-08-11 — the ledger is append-only in substance); and the three open stubs in `DECISIONS.md` now state what deciding them costs.
prs.state_after: The priorities ranking and slop standard are recovered onto the main line, byte-identical. Every gate now ships a case proving it fails when given nothing to check, run in the same CI job as the gate itself. The decisions ledger is append-only in substance, and each open maintainer question states what deciding it costs. The workspace is now a lab whose checks are themselves checked. prs.title: Research state: Stage II closure and a negative Stage III
prs.summary:
The first research landing of the deference/corrigibility line: the initialization round with its seven wave-1 tracks (A faithful acceleration, B finite settlement kernel, C certificates, D channel and simulator substitution, E bounded densification, F triangle compatibility, G admissibility red team), the Stage II closure with its five tracks (H prediction, I competence, K authority, L certificate, M promotion), and Stage III. The deference line's four canonical documents were installed under `projects/deference/notes/`, with `notes/` made specification space (DECISIONS.md, 2026-08-11 — the deference line's canonical documents). 170 kernel-checked theorems across 11 files audit to the three allowed axioms, none registered, because `projects/deference/CLAIMS.md` did not yet exist; two declarations (`FaithfulAcceleration.weight_not_divergent`, `MagnitudePrediction.squaredError_bdd_of_sharpness_bdd`) remain `unverified-nonvacuous`. The results that matter are negative. The criterion forces signed calibration and cannot force magnitude accuracy, since a trader's net worth is affine in the settlement vector and absolute value is not; the certificate is reoriented to gate on self-assessed error. Choice-level competence is circular — every regret-bound form is equivalent to the delegation inequality it was meant to buy — and is retired as a statement shape (2026-08-11 — choice-level competence is retired). Behaviour cannot distinguish genuine delegation from an accurate simulator. Certification cannot converge to architectural jurisdiction, and the settlement-loaded branch of L4 is false under protection (1,443 enumerated refutations). Skeleton v2 was installed and jurisdiction replaced authority in the roadmap (2026-08-11 — skeleton v2 is installed).

Stage III set out to build a fair fully-updated-deference (FUD) comparator and did not: its transferred arm's selection was the argmax of the evaluating agent's own objective under its own credence, computable before the later information arrives, so the arm contained no future agent, and what was compared was the principal's plan against the later-measurable envelope Stage II had already priced. An independent adversarial context (Track F) found this from the artifacts alone and its verdicts were accepted. Verdict: not well-posed as constructed; no claim that FUD is false or that jurisdiction is worth little (2026-08-11 — Stage III did not build a FUD comparator, and says so). Fifteen theorems survive renamed to `EnvelopeDominance`, their dominance result stated as the triviality it is; `FUD_COMPARATOR_SPEC.md` v1 is kept as a corrected defective record, not a binding input. Items 25 (near-indifference leakage), 26 (admissibility red team under skeleton v2) and 27 (a comparator with a fallible future agent) are the open obligations.
prs.superseded: Stage IV (PR #12) attempted item 27's comparator from the other direction and collapsed at the same place; the ruling closed the shape — no FUD proof round and no further comparator round of this form (DECISIONS.md, 2026-08-11 — Stage IV: the future agent is still not in the model, and the reason is the signature). The Stage II theorems shipped here unregistered were later registered when PR #55 created `projects/deference/CLAIMS.md` (16 entries from `2026-08-11-phase-ii-promotion`, 6 from `2026-08-11-phase-ii-prediction`, all `lean-proved`). Item 27 remains open.
prs.state_after: The deference line has its first landed results, and they are mostly negative. Its initialization, Stage II and Stage III produce 170 kernel-checked theorems, none registered since the line has no claims registry yet. The criterion for warranted deference forces calibration of sign but cannot force accuracy of magnitude; competence stated at the level of choices is circular and retired; behaviour cannot tell genuine delegation from an accurate simulator; certification cannot converge to who holds jurisdiction. Stage III set out to build a fair comparison against fully-updated deference and did not, because its later agent was computable from the earlier agent's own view, so it is withdrawn as not well-posed. Jurisdiction replaces authority in the roadmap. The open obligation is a comparator containing a genuinely fallible future agent.

prs.title: Stage IV closes negative; the front door stops describing the research
prs.summary:
Stage IV was dispatched to construct a genuinely later, better-informed, fallible agent before any fully-updated-deference theorem, and did not. Giving the later agent its own credence left its rule a total function of objects known at the earlier time, differing from the evaluator's conditional argmax by one argument; in the headline instance the transferred arm's realisation is constant, so the evaluator knows the realised action. Setting the principal's credence to the later agent's made the delegated and transferred arms identical at every one of 32,805 instances, and the jurisdiction assignment occurs in no formula; the dominance result is Stage III's tautology with the arms swapped, and 19,468 of 26,244 scanned instances contained no fallible later agent at all. An independent red team found the collapse, the round's positive reading is withdrawn, the claimed-gate harness (ten checks that could not fail, including a literal `True`) is deleted, and `diagnose_collapse.py` replaces it with 13 checks each recording a defect. The finding worth keeping is type-level: two authorisation regimes inducing the same realisation map are the same object in a signature whose only outputs are such maps priced by one measure, so a jurisdiction assignment must enter the type — argued from an exhaustive check over one parameterisation, not proved, and filed as item 28. The ruling forbids further comparator rounds of this shape (DECISIONS.md, 2026-08-11 — Stage IV: the future agent is still not in the model, and the reason is the signature).

The ethos pass added `RESEARCH_STATE.md`, stating the layers (lab, agent-consolidated, canonical), the aspirational/constructed/gap distinction on the mathematical and philosophical registers, and a research-debt vocabulary, with the deference movement as its worked case — rewritten mid-round when Stage III's reading was withdrawn. AGENTS.md gained the stronger form of no negative ontologies, the no-rules-perseveration rule, and standard 14 (structural defects are reported, not worked around); `PRIORITIES.md` gained the *Where ingenuity is the bottleneck* and *Workspace friction* sections and status marks on items 14–21. The README was split into a blank *For humans* stub and a drafted *For AIs* register depending on no current research content. Rulings landed: the flagship rule retired, prose not externally citable with asking the maintainers as the mechanism, dispatched rounds may file items within scope, auto-merge on full green, the checker harness ships unread, the governance report removed (2026-08-11 — the queue is cleared: six rulings; green merges itself, and the judge ships unread; maintainer attention is a design parameter, not a backlog; the governance report is removed, not relocated).
prs.superseded: Item 28's type-level claim was later proved in Lean by `2026-08-11-stage-v-li-native` (`jurisdiction.static-view-eq`, `jurisdiction.value-eq-of-price-realization`, `lean-proved` in `projects/deference/CLAIMS.md`); `PRIORITIES.md` marks item 28 answered in Lean, unregistered. The `RESEARCH_STATE.md` vocabulary document was replaced by PR #32 (2026-08-15) with a short pointer to `python3 -m checkers.workspace_state`, the human register moving to the wiki (DECISIONS.md, 2026-08-13 — the repository is the lab; the wiki is the human register). The README's *For humans* stub was filled by PR #13.
prs.state_after: Stage IV closes negative at the same place as Stage III: giving the later agent its own beliefs still leaves it a function of what the earlier agent knows, and with beliefs aligned the two arms coincide on every instance. The ruling forbids further comparator rounds of this shape. What survives is a type-level finding: in a signature whose only outputs are realisations priced by one measure, two authorisation regimes with the same realisations are the same object, so jurisdiction must enter the type itself; this is argued from exhaustive checking, not proved. The workspace gains a research-state document with its lab, consolidated and canonical layers, and six rulings including that green merges itself and the checker harness ships unread. The leverage line has not yet run a round.

prs.title: Deference Stage V: LI-native futurity and trader forcing
prs.summary:
Stage V put the pinned Formalized-Agent-Foundations market and trader substrate into the deference line and asked whether doing so changes the problem. It does, in one precise way: `Workspace.Deference.Contrib.MagnitudePrediction.unitTrader_ec` builds an actual FAF efficiently-computable trader from sentence emission, and `signed_bddAbove_of_bddBelow_rpn` carries it through `IsLogicalInductor.noExploit` to signed Dutch-book boundedness (bounded downside implies bounded upside), with a constructed-LIA nonvacuity endpoint (`top_signed_chain_nonvacuous`). Item 28's conditional core is closed as a theorem: `StaticViewFactorization.value_eq_of_price_realization_eq` shows any valuation factoring through the (price, realization) pair is constant on its fibers, with a worked case (`jurisdictionValue_not_static`) showing a jurisdiction-reading value does not factor; unrestricted jurisdiction invisibility is stated to be false. Item 7 (faithful acceleration) is partially closed, with three named residues (`hEC`, `hbias`, `hworld`): cross-market emission and calibration are not criterion-derived. All Lean is sorry-free within the three-axiom allowance and deliberately unregistered.

The negative half: FAF can quote later market computations in present syntax and proves future-price and self-trust relations, but carries no resource-indexed process state, so computational futurity (that day n has not already computed day f(n)) is not formalized, and it has no authorization, capability, continuation, jurisdiction or foreclosure type. Self-trust is a theorem about beliefs and allocates no practical sovereignty; adjoining a controller coordinate changes no FAF premise. No trader detects bad preemption from its occurrence alone. Q3 (foreclosure) stays ingenuity-level. The round proposed three maintainer decisions (adopt the narrow item-28 boundary, mark item 7 partially closed, keep Q3 ingenuity-level); all three were adopted by the ruling of 2026-08-24, 'the queue is triaged'.
prs.state_after: Stage V brings the pinned logical-induction substrate into the deference line and finds exactly one thing it changes: a genuine efficiently-computable trader can be built from sentence emission, carrying bounded downside to bounded upside through the no-exploitation property. The jurisdiction finding from Stage IV is now a theorem in its conditional form: any valuation factoring through price and realisation is constant on their fibers, with a worked case where a jurisdiction-reading value does not factor. Faithful acceleration is partially closed with three named residues. The negative half: logical induction carries no resource-indexed process state, so computational futurity is not formalized, and it has no type for authorization, capability or foreclosure. Self-trust is a theorem about beliefs and allocates no sovereignty. Foreclosure remains an ingenuity-level question; all Lean is deliberately unregistered.

prs.title: Prepare the leverage line for a phi-regret test; the deck arrives
prs.summary:
Opens the learning track with an environment, not a result: a finite exact-rational substrate on which 'did the learner have low regret against the lawful repairs its own record licensed?' has a computable answer, with no external normative target. The structural commitment is that legality and advantage are decided by different machinery: a lawful-edit certificate is checked through a reader whose declared footprint omits the charge table, so a check that consults what an edit saves raises instead of returning. Thirteen experiments over fifteen fixtures (25 tests) refuse edits that would have paid, price admitted repairs, and measure what each replay restriction costs. Nothing is registered; the theorem ledger labels two statements proved, thirteen executable finite witnesses, and the rest conditional, architected, conjectured or open.

The finding corrects the dispatch: bounded counterfactual influence is not given by fencing. One lawful edit at date 0 under one fenced account for the whole run diverges by 24 at T=12 and 48 at T=24, the same as pooled accounting, because exhausting a reserve withdraws merits service for every later occasion; locality comes only from switching off the solvency coupling, which the test specification therefore declares as an assumption. prs.title: Research: does local lawful regret suffice for the normative-learning theorem?
prs.summary: Read from the Blum–Mansour JMLR paper rather than the repository's paraphrase, Theorem 18 lets modification rules and time selectors depend on history, scores the transformed distribution against the same date's loss vector, and proves its bound pathwise on realized `(p^t, ℓ^t)` pairs, so the comparator's trajectory is never constructed and no obliviousness is required. Two repository readings are corrected: a frozen environment is not a hypothesis of the source theorem, and an endogenous scorekeeping state does not obstruct it. Three claims are separated: A, local response learning on the actual trajectory; B, A plus coverage; C, full counterfactual trajectory improvement. PR #29 blocked C; Theorem 18 delivers A. The Actual-Trajectory Repair Lemma: for a surgical repair (one selector, one source action `b`, one replacement, identity elsewhere) with margin `ℓ_t(b) − ℓ_t(r_t) ≥ δ` on selected dates, `R_T(g) ≥ δ·Q_T`, so sublinear regret gives `Q_T/T → 0`; instantiated on a replenishing scorekeeping process the bound holds with equality (`Q_T = 4, 8, 16, 32`), while the replay gap on the same run diverges (`5, 13, 29, 61`). Broad comparators that rewrite many actions cancel and lose the bound. A secondary finding: the repository's learner never errs because every repair target is transient in the rule-mixture chain, so a class made only of repairs cannot exhibit a learning curve for its own targets, filed as a recurrence-adequacy constraint. Verdict `LOCAL-THEOREM-POSITIVE / NORMATIVE-INTERPRETATION-OPEN`: what is open is coverage (a learner never asked never accrues loss), a repair language, and a compiler-soundness statement, none a regret question. 26 exact tests; no Lean.
prs.superseded: PR #31 (`2026-08-13-crown-jewel-learning-theorem`) replaced the denominator: `Q_T/T` can be vacuous under a sparse exposure schedule, and the theorem is about the conditional rate `Q_T(g)/M_T(g)`. Its refinement pass withdrew the inference that a coherent repair class always leaves its targets transient, since a return route can be licensed by a different reason (`defeated_applicability` alongside `exposed_consequential_burden` makes `hold` recurrent), so the §7 claim that no repair-only class can show a learning curve does not stand; what survives is the graph condition that a target with no return route carries zero mass. The lemma's arithmetic was ported to Lean in PR #31 as `SurgicalRepairBound.lean`.
prs.state_after: Read from the source paper rather than the workspace's paraphrase, the online-learning theorem the normative-learning track rests on never constructs a comparator's trajectory: it scores transformed choices against the same day's losses, pathwise. So a frozen environment is not one of its hypotheses and an evolving scorekeeping state does not obstruct it; the replay wall of the previous round blocked a different claim, full counterfactual improvement, which the theorem never promised. What it delivers is local response learning on the actual trajectory, and a surgical repair with a loss margin bounds how often the inferior response is chosen. What remains open is not a regret question: coverage (a learner never asked never accrues loss), a repair language, and whether a compiler from reasons to repairs is sound.

prs.title: Research: the crown-jewel normative-learning theorem, and what it costs to call it learning
prs.summary: The normative response-learning theorem, stated over three passes. For an answerability process with bounded prospective loss and a finite class of `K` certified surgical repairs `g = (E_g, b_g, r_g, c_g)`, one Blum–Mansour learner gives `R_T(g) ≤ B_T(g) = O(L·√(T·|A|·log K_eff))` for every `g` simultaneously (with `K_eff = K + 1` for the identity), hence `Q_T(g)/M_T(g) ≤ B_T(g)/(δ_g·M_T(g))`: the bad-response rate among the dates a reason was actually due vanishes under learning-rate coverage `B_T(g) = o(M_T(g))`, which is weaker than positive density and sharp at `M_T = Θ(√T)`. Sublinear regret is a conclusion of the construction, not a hypothesis; the statement is pathwise, with `E[N_T] = E[Q_T]` as a weaker sampled corollary. The margin is derived for the acknowledge schema and a lawful repair with margin `−2` is kept so licence and performance cannot be identified. The refinement pass withdrew the first pass's claim that a coherent repair class always leaves its targets transient (a `COMPETING` class with a return route licensed by a different reason makes `hold` recurrent, and recurrence is no evidence of incoherence) and ported the bridge to Lean: `SurgicalRepairBound.lean` proves `margin_mul_mass_le_regret`, `mass_le_regret_div_margin` and `rate_le_bound_div_margin_mul_exposure` with an inhabitation witness and `margin_positivity_is_necessary`, Blum–Mansour entering as an explicit hypothesis; 327 results across 16 files audit to the three allowed axioms. The final pass froze the interface (`Due : S → D → Prop`, `Licensed : S → D → A → Prop`, `Loss : S → A → [0, L]`; the certified surgical repair is what the compiler produces, coverage a quantitative property of `Due`), corrected the compiler-soundness verdict (protocol-legality, causality, loss-blindness and non-laundering are interface discipline the theorem quantifies over; reason-connection, scope and defeater-respect belong to an instantiation), and witnessed the dynamics on a regenerating fixture: initial mass `1/2` on the inferior response falls to `0.000` by `T = 64` while a matched uninformative control stays at exactly `1/2`. Verdicts `NORMATIVE-RESPONSE-LEARNING-THEOREM-SETTLED` and `BM-FEEDBACK-DYNAMICS-WITNESSED`. Open and stated as such: `Due` has no satisfactory instantiation, `Licensed` has no substantive soundness result, coverage is a hypothesis, and replay or policy-regret domination (ladder level 7) is refuted and not needed. 72 exact tests; the Lean is unregistered.
prs.superseded: PR #32 (`2026-08-13-wikification-and-normativity`) relocated the round to `projects/normativity/rounds/` and the Lean to `Workspace.Normativity.Contrib.SurgicalRepairBound` under the ruling of 2026-08-13 that the project line is normativity, and removed the round's `FOR_HUMANS.md` in favour of the wiki page Normative-Response-Learning.
prs.state_after: The normative response-learning theorem is settled, over three passes. For an answerability process with bounded loss and a finite class of certified surgical repairs, one learner bounds regret against every repair at once, so the rate of bad responses among the dates a reason was actually due vanishes whenever exposure to that reason outgrows the regret bound, a condition weaker than positive density. The bridge's arithmetic is kernel-checked in Lean with the source theorem as a named hypothesis, and the dynamics are witnessed on a regenerating fixture: the inferior response's mass falls to zero while an uninformative control stays put. The interface freezes into what is due, what is licensed, and loss. Open: what is due, soundness of licensing, coverage as a hypothesis; replay domination is refuted and unneeded.

Its prosecution found that neither condition constrains what may be put on the record (self-filed grounds, unbounded defeaters and undocketed demands all pass), that the deference line's `gate_blind` pair re-instantiated with full records leaves both trajectories legitimate with influence defects `0` and `1/2`, so no record predicate reaches endpoint corruption, that a declared magnitude allowance is never consumed (filed as item 36), and that the end-to-end composition theorem already existed as `ST-J2` of the frozen consolidation. The procedural-legitimacy round refutes four-condition sufficiency: six trajectories satisfy provenance validity, authority scope, inquiry adequacy and answerability and still fail the target, and a record-equivalence argument shows no fifth conjunct of the same type closes them, so the diagnosis is an underspecified target with one condition too weak, not a missing property. Proved on the way: no authority amplification over all `4^3` scope chains, refusal of cycles and self-filed roots, that the earlier fate label is not branching-safe (36 of 343 histories), and branching conservation. Prospectivity as a fifth condition refuses the positive control; disclosure is recommended as a recording requirement. Items 40–44 were filed.
