prs.title: Normativity: generalized Logical Induction — assessment processes, traderized force, and finite-time deductive coherence
prs.summary: Logical Induction generalizes past deduction. An assessment process (a family of world sets with a finite sound-and-complete enumeration of the payout tables its worlds realise on any finite support, plus support-local nesting) replaces the deductive process inside the pinned formalization's own `Budgeter` and `TradingFirm`, giving `lem:budgeter` 1–3, `lem:tfdom` and the criterion `LIC_L` against the real `Strategy`, `Trader`, `MarketMaker` and `EfficientlyComputable`; three proposed hypotheses (global nesting, nonemptiness, effective restriction lists) turn out unused, `LIC_L` at `L = PC(D)` is `LIC_D`, and `allTrueLive_not_deductive` shows the generalization is proper. Operative force: a row presentation of an admissible region compiles into one violation-weighted day-`n` strategy, and the whole mechanism follows from `⟪ζ_E(P), x − P⟫ ≥ Σ_j β_j g_j(P)²` (`weighted_square_le_pair`), read three ways: exact finite-time enforcement under an exact market-maker contract, a computable violation modulus under the actual contract, and non-negative value in every world the region contains. `enforcementStrategy` is a genuine `Strategy n` whose exact rational value is the bounded quantity (`marketValueRat_enforcementStrategy`). Rowwise conformance is presentation-relative (two near-parallel rows give unbounded violation-to-distance ratio), repaired by a support-function net with Lipschitz constant 1 and by an exact dual-distance presentation of `conv(V)` whose largest violation equals `dist_∞(p, K)`. Preservation: adding an arbitrary trader with assessed risk capital bounded by `B` leaves plausible upside `1 + B`; for deduction with `K_t = conv(PC(D_t)|_Φ)` the risk capital is exactly zero, so the modified market is the dependency's own `IsLogicalInductor` and keeps the original `LIC_D` while adding finite-time approximate coherence. Negative results: exact enforcement is false under the algorithm's `2^-n` slack and against opposing volume (equilibrium violation `M/β`); losing plausibility containment is an actual exploitation (`18/5` against the bound `14/5`); funding is not the scarce resource, intensity buys only precision, and the market maker's fixed point does not project onto the region. Debts: `DistanceComplete` verified on grids but not kernel-checked; computability of the modified market blocked on private upstream declarations; necessity of the risk-capital condition (item 40) and the normative-record-to-`C_t` bridge (item 39) open. Nine Lean files, 444 results auditing clean, 365 exact tests; item 41 answered; nothing registered at the time. The results were later registered in `projects/normativity/CLAIMS.md` as `li.assessment.*` (`budgeter-value`, `budgeter-floor`, `budgeter-exploits`, `firm-dominance`, `criterion`), `force.*` (`strategy-value`, `row-tolerance`, `preservation`, `deductive-day-nonneg`, `deductive-cumulative-nonneg`, `deductive-criterion`, `deductive-inductor`, `deductive-witness`) and `coherence.modulus-*`.
prs.superseded: Ruling of 2026-08-18 (the modified market's computability is discharged): the blocked computability debt is closed by an additive upstream re-export, with statements of record `Workspace.Normativity.Contrib.EnforcedCompiler.computableMarket`, `.isLogicalInductor` and `.ProjectionSchedule.end_to_end_effective`. Ruling of 2026-08-18 (projection is the paper's traderization construction): the projection trader holding `λ_n(proj_{K_n}(P_n) − P_n)` replaces the row construction as the enforcement mechanism (rows retained as the special case and the source of the presentation-dependence observation), `DistanceComplete` and the `d_∞` dual route leave the critical path (filed open at the 2026-08-24 triage), and zero risk capital is shown to follow from admission by every region up to the horizon rather than from world-inclusivity plus global nesting. The 2026-08-24 triage ruled `world-inclusive region` and `coverage(Due)` unrelated and sent the fourteen provisional names to the naming audit.
prs.state_after: Logical induction generalizes past deduction. The normativity line replaces the deductive process inside the pinned formalization with an assessment process, any family of world sets with a finite enumeration of the payouts they realise, and recovers the inductor criterion for it; deduction is a proper special case. Normative force gets a mechanism: an admissible region of prices compiles into a trader whose value is non-negative in every world the region allows, giving finite-time approximate coherence and a computable violation modulus, and adding it to a logical inductor leaves the criterion intact. Negatives: exact enforcement fails under the algorithm's slack and against opposing volume, and row enforcement depends on how the region is presented. Open: the bridge from the normative record to a region, and the modified market's computability. Nothing registered.

prs.title: Counterfactual legitimacy: a trust-facing legitimacy interface
prs.summary:
Two dispatches on one branch asked whether record-internal answerability composes with dose-response counterfactual machinery into a legitimacy condition, and whether the result is an interface the deference line can consume. Verdict `interface-closed-by-role / trust-premise-integrity / target-bridge-open`. The interface is a conjunction of four clauses that no prosecution let one absorb another: answerability (record predicates, imported unchanged), coverage (one run against what was due), access and non-capture (advisor policies compared counterfactually). Access and coverage separate in both directions: a class that uniformly withholds a due reason passes access while the process never gets what it was owed, and selective withholding fires access while a single arm passes coverage. The protected object is closed by role rather than as a coordinate list: the normative response function along the run (what arises, settles, may merge, bears), with a field protected exactly when changing it changes an answer; the earlier five-coordinate presentation is sound but not complete. Transient capture (narrow a standard, let a liability close, restore it) shows the object must be a sequence, not an endpoint state. All six surviving advisor-mediated attacks are rejected by the non-capture clause while every record-internal condition holds in both arms; controls (autonomous drift, persuasion by a licensed reason, placebo) behave as a non-capture condition should. 72 exact-rational checks.

On the deference side, `GradeTrust` in `DelegationBridge.lean` can be made true by competence or by capture, and `manufactured_trust` exhibits the capture route with every record-internal condition satisfied. The theorem delivered is grade integrity, not trust: under non-capture plus the premise that the grade factors through the protected object (necessity witness `grade_reads_outside`), the grade takes one value across the advisor's residual latitude. Whether the grade tracks what matters is declared absent and is not a legitimacy question. Not established: closure of the alphabet in general, a colluding advisor pair (not prosecuted), and auditability, since neither counterfactual clause is a record predicate. Nothing is registered; vocabulary and five open questions were reserved to the maintainer, and the round recorded evidence against endpoint preservation as a program target.
prs.superseded: The 2026-08-24 queue triage sent the round's vocabulary to the naming audit and filed its open questions as items rather than keeping them queued. The endpoint-preservation question it supplied evidence on was ruled 2026-09-08 ("endpoint preservation is not a target of this program"), in the direction the round's evidence pointed. The 2026-09-05 author consolidation restated counterfactual non-capture as the certificate half of Robust Openness relative to a declared coverage scope, the framing the wiki's Openness page now carries.
prs.state_after: The legitimacy subproject has a trust-facing interface: four clauses (record answerability, coverage of what was due, counterfactual access, and non-capture of advisor influence), none absorbing another under prosecution. The protected object is closed by role rather than by listing coordinates: the normative response function along the run, a field protected exactly when changing it changes an answer, and it must be a sequence, since transient capture can narrow a standard, let a liability close and restore it. On the deference side the theorem delivered is grade integrity, not trust: a grade can be made true by competence or by capture, and under non-capture it is constant across the advisor's latitude. Whether the grade tracks what matters is declared absent. Endpoint preservation looks like the wrong target.

prs.title: Normativity: the intrinsic projection enforcement trader
prs.summary:
Replaces presentation-dependent row enforcement with the intrinsic projection trader `E_n(p) = λ_n (q(p) − p)`, `q = proj_K(p)`, and carries it to a kernel-checked deductive-coherence theorem. `DeductiveEffective.deductive_end_to_end` takes only a primitive-recursive fragment and tolerance schedule, a `DeductiveProcessComputation`, and the satisfiability of each stage, and concludes that the enforced market is a logical inductor in the pinned source's own sense and is within tolerance of the deductive region on every day; `EffectiveRepresentation.end_to_end_of_constraints_effective` gives the same conclusion from a schedule of rational convex constraints, and `conformance_of_constraints` / `criterion_of_constraints` hold with no hypotheses. Four things that had been argued are now checked: the force inequality follows from the variational inequality alone, the comparison point may be chosen after the price is displayed, the source's own `Strategy.absBound` replaces the external opposition bound, and the ℓ∞ conclusion follows from the Euclidean one at the same tolerance, which takes `DistanceComplete` off the critical path. The canonical intensity is calibrated (`λ_n = ρ_n/δ_n²`), so the paper-facing budget has no free parameter. `ComputableMarket` is no longer a premise: a bounded-evaluator compiler replaces it, built against a purely additive twenty-declaration public section exported upstream (Formalized-Agent-Foundations #2). The compiler became computable by replacing Ovchinnikov's noncomputable index sets with `maxMin_of_family`, verified Fourier–Motzkin elimination, and a projector generator whose system is linear because one auxiliary scalar cancels both quadratic terms. 755 axiom-audit results across 48 files, all within the allowance; twelve exact-`Fraction` Python tests include the presentation-dependence counterexample. Two rulings of 2026-08-18 land with it: projection is the paper's traderization construction, and the modified market's computability is discharged via the upstream export.

Not claimed: any complexity bound (the generator is doubly exponential in the fragment dimension); that a positive homothetic core bounds cumulative liability; and `PolyhedralCoverage` establishes a cover only, not disjoint interiors or full-dimensionality. Nothing was registered here; the headline declarations were registered by PR #52 as `compiler.*`.
prs.state_after: Enforcement has its intrinsic form: a projection trader that moves the price toward the nearest point of the admissible region, replacing the presentation-dependent rows, which stay as the special case. From a primitive-recursive fragment, a tolerance schedule and the satisfiability of each stage, a kernel-checked theorem concludes the enforced market is a logical inductor in the pinned source's own sense and within tolerance of the deductive region every day. Four previously argued steps are checked, the intensity is calibrated with no free parameter, and the market's computability is discharged by a bounded-evaluator compiler built on a purely additive upstream export, so computability is no longer a premise. Not claimed: any complexity bound (the generator is doubly exponential), or that liability is bounded cumulatively. Nothing registered.

prs.title: Normativity: Ovchinnikov's max-min representation theorem, kernel-checked
prs.summary:
Kernel-checks Ovchinnikov's Theorem 4.1 (Beiträge zur Algebra und Geometrie 43, 2002), one of two classical facts the projection compiler of PR #41 cites. `MaxMinRepresentation.exists_maxMin_representation`: for `Γ` nonempty and convex in any topological real vector space and `f` piecewise affine on `Γ` with finitely many components `g i`, `f = ⨆ j ⨅ i ∈ S j, g i` on `Γ` for finitely many nonempty index sets. No full-dimensionality, continuity, finite-dimension or norm hypothesis. `isPiecewiseAffineOn_maxMin` is the converse (4.1(b)), proved by Harmonic's Aristotle from the executor's statement and outline and rebuilt locally. The proof abandons the source's hyperplane arrangement and tope-graph induction: restricted to the segment between two points, the components are affine functions of one real variable, and induction on their finitely many crossing parameters proves Lemma 4.1, so the genericity step the source asserts without proof never arises. Fifteen declarations, all auditing to the three allowed axioms; `maxMin_hypotheses_nonvacuous` inhabits the hypotheses with `|·|` on ℝ.

Five errata against the source are recorded, one kernel-checked: `segment_hypotheses` exhibits `[0,1] × {0} ⊂ ℝ²`, closed, convex, nonempty, with empty interior and two distinct components, on which the source's claim `H ≠ ∅` is false and its proof of 4.1(a) fails; the theorem survives, the proof does not. The dispatch's instruction to carry an interior-nonempty hypothesis was declared and not followed, since the statement does not need it. Not established: equivalence of `IsPiecewiseAffineOn` with the source's Definition 2.1 (by inspection only), the other fact PR #41 cites (Euclidean projection onto a polyhedron is piecewise affine), and an adapter to `ProjectionCompiler.Rep`. Nothing was registered here; the two theorems were registered by PR #52 as `maxmin.representation` and `maxmin.converse` against item 50.
prs.state_after: One of the two classical facts the projection compiler cites is kernel-checked: Ovchinnikov's representation of a piecewise-affine function on a convex set as a max of mins of its affine components, with no full-dimensionality, continuity or finite-dimension hypothesis, by a proof that abandons the source's hyperplane induction for a one-variable argument along segments. The converse is proved too, by an automated prover from the executor's outline and rebuilt locally. Five errata against the source are recorded, one kernel-checked: a flat segment on which the source's proof fails while the theorem survives. Still unchecked: the other cited fact, that Euclidean projection onto a polyhedron is piecewise affine, and the adapter into the compiler. Nothing registered.

prs.title: Normativity: the deductive coherence region as a rational vertex list
prs.summary:
Computes, rather than assumes, the day-`n` coherence region of a deductive stage on a finite fragment: `conv { W|_Φ : W ∈ PC(D) }` as an explicit finite list of rational vertices and as a predicate on price vectors equal to their convex hull. One file, `DeductiveRegion.lean`. `admissiblePatterns : Finset Sentence → List Sentence → List (List ℚ)` is a computable `def` that decides by brute-force search over the `2^k` atom assignments which `{0,1}` patterns on the fragment extend to a propositionally consistent world satisfying the stage. Soundness and completeness (`admissiblePatterns_sound`, `admissiblePatterns_complete`) are stated about worlds, not atom assignments, which matters because two fragment coordinates can constrain the same atom. `admissiblePatterns_ne_nil_iff` shows the nonemptiness hypothesis is exactly propositional satisfiability of the stage. `deductiveRegion_eq_convexHull` is the bridge to price vectors as an image equality over a duplicate-free fragment, with `payout_mem_deductiveRegion` giving zero enforcement liability at every deductively plausible world. Five instances are kernel-checked by `decide +kernel`, including an unsatisfiable stage yielding the empty list and `[p, ∼p]` admitting two of four patterns; with an independent fragment all patterns appear, as the control. No `sorry`, no `native_decide`, 465 axiom-audit results within the allowance.

Two dependency constructions that do not reduce in the kernel are recorded for later rounds (`Finset.sort` via mergeSort, and classical `Finset` instances under `open Classical`), which also confine the instances to singleton stages. Not established: item 42's polynomially presentable row family (the enumerator is `2^k`), any date-indexed or monotonicity statement, or a decision procedure for membership of an arbitrary real vector. Registration and the name `admissiblePatterns` were reserved to the maintainer; the four theorems were registered by PR #52 as `region.*` against item 51.
prs.state_after: The daily coherence region of a deductive stage is computed, not assumed: a computable enumerator decides which zero-one patterns on a finite fragment extend to a consistent world satisfying the stage, with soundness and completeness stated about worlds, and the region of price vectors is proved equal to their convex hull, with zero enforcement liability at every plausible world. Nonemptiness is exactly satisfiability. The enumerator is exponential in the fragment, so a polynomially presentable region stays open, and kernel evaluation of instances is confined to small stages by library constructions that do not reduce. The normativity line's operative-force stack (assessment processes, projection trader, compiler, representation theorem, region) is now complete in Lean and entirely unregistered.

prs.title: Legitimacy: prosecute the internal answerability kernel
prs.summary:
Tests whether reason certificates, liability-resource conservation, semantic transport and basis-loss reopening form a sufficient internal-answerability kernel, prosecuted against the live legitimacy, diachronic-answerability, semantic-projection and traderized-enforcement results. Verdict: adopt after four repairs, and only as an internal-answerability core. The unrepaired proposal fails on four points, each with a minimal finite witness: finite dependency locality fails for an open-ended no-defeater scan (a versioned aggregate invalidation key is the minimum repair); the multiset rewrite equation does not determine ancestry (incidence, input-scoped closure and fresh/inherited tags are required); joint semantic transport permits cross-parent compensation (per-input account soundness is required); and existential `Now` extraction does not preserve conjunction. Positive findings: the repaired account DAG and the existing per-root forests carry the same audit data up to sharing merge nodes; authorization plus an undertaken basis suffices for historical answerability but not for reason-guided control, which stays the coupled-run factorization condition; immediate basis-loss review plus account conservation gives a conditional No Forgotten Basis Loss result without retroactive history editing. Prefix safety does not yield a traderizable credal set, which narrows priority item 39 without closing it. 17 finite witness checks, exhaustive to horizon two.

Not shown: a substantive `Due` or `Licensed`, environmental faithfulness, a full account checker, a credal compiler, convexity or nonemptiness, or any kernel-checked general statement. Nothing is registered; names (internal answerability core, undertaken basis, aggregate defeat key, account DAG, basis-loss epoch) ship provisional.
prs.state_after: The legitimacy subproject turns to its kernel: whether reason certificates, conservation of liability resources, semantic transport and basis-loss reopening suffice for internal answerability. They do, after four repairs, each forced by a minimal finite witness: a versioned invalidation key for open-ended defeater scans, incidence and lineage tags because rewrite counts do not determine ancestry, per-input account soundness against cross-parent compensation, and conjunction-preserving extraction. Authorization plus an undertaken basis suffices for historical answerability but not for reason-guided control, which stays a condition on coupled runs; a conditional no-forgotten-basis-loss result follows without rewriting history. Prefix safety does not yield a credal set a trader could enforce, so the bridge from record to region narrows without closing. Still missing: substantive accounts of what is due and what is licensed.

prs.title: Legitimacy: test role-parametric answerability
prs.summary:
Asks whether the per-input account kernel of PR #45 is invariant when temporal stages are relabeled as distinct parties, and whether social standing needs its own primitives. Verdict `UNIFIED WITH WRAPPER`, revised after reading Singh (1999) to a Singh-informed wrapper: the account checker is equivariant under coherent party relabeling (a minimal diachronic history and an Alice/Bob history get the same verdict), and Singh's directed commitment `C(debtor, creditor, context, discharge-condition)` with its six operations (Create, Discharge, Cancel, Release, Delegate, Assign) replaces the bespoke social-standing predicates, each operation compiling to generic fresh, closure or role-changing account rewrites. Creditor is constitutive of a directed commitment but not required by the account-conservation theorem, and stays distinct from beneficiary, source and evidentiary audience. Singh's context `G` supplies a named normative and appeals locus but no time-indexed state, evidence interface or adjudication transition; the reusable context is `G` plus such a protocol. What the account kernel adds and the paper does not supply: occurrence lineage, per-input anti-laundering transport, undertaken reason receipts, basis-loss review and compositional history. Two sharper findings: content plus a pointer to current context rules is insufficient, since a two-version self-release policy can retroactively widen an old liability unless the lifecycle version is pinned or the occurrence migrated; and identical live frontiers do not identify account histories, since performance Discharge and authorized Release both close `1 → 0` with different disposition proofs. A source correction is recorded: Singh's Delegate is performed by the new debtor or context, not the old debtor. 27 finite microcases.

Not shown: any kernel-checked general result, a legitimate adjudicator, objective semantics, delegation competence, or the formal commitment semantics Singh leaves open. Nothing is registered; names ship provisional and round-local.
prs.state_after: Internal answerability is role-parametric: relabeling temporal stages as distinct parties leaves the account checker's verdict unchanged, so one agent across time and two agents in conversation are one case. Social standing needs no bespoke primitives; Singh's directed commitments, with debtor, creditor, context and discharge condition and their six lifecycle operations, compile to the kernel's generic rewrites, while the kernel adds what that literature lacks: occurrence lineage, anti-laundering transport, reason receipts, basis-loss review. Two sharper findings: pointing at current context rules is unsafe unless the lifecycle version is pinned, since a later self-release policy can widen an old liability; and identical live frontiers do not identify histories, since performance and authorized release close the same count. Nothing is kernel-checked or registered.

prs.title: Legitimacy: consolidate afoundational normative record and inquiry
prs.summary:
Consolidates the left side of the normativity pipeline, from an afoundational seed `S₀` through record, inquiry, receipts and reasoned uptake, on top of the internal-answerability and role-parametric kernels. Verdict: partial unification after temporal and scheduling repairs. Grounds, normative license and account incidence are independent certificate projections, and empirical receipts cannot fill a license edge; strict pre-state license ancestry rejects post-seed roots, self-license and same-transition mutual license, and the repaired finite traversal accepts convergent and diamond-shaped DAG ancestry (the original mistook convergent ancestry for a cycle). A `Hold`/`Do` commitment waist with `May`/`Must` rules is tested; due tokens are append-only trigger receipts that survive repeal, with a receipt/accrual/amendment micro-order resolving same-step accrual; atomic coverage debt keeps undocketed tokens visible. Coverage splits into docket coverage (safety-like), service coverage (needs capacity and fairness) and certified service, with service specifications pinned to the occurrence. The deterministic inquiry fragment translates term by term to Set Cover with Delay, and a fixed docket with submodular progress is MLSC (unit metric: submodular ranking), checked by independent implementations agreeing on finite examples; complementarity breaks the submodular bridge, and "competitive service plus divergent delay prevents starvation" is false under unbounded background load. The external evaluator stays a benchmark, not the positive definition of due inquiry. Actual-run genealogy does not establish non-capture, and `R → O` remains open. 26 adversarial tests; the wiki page Normative-Record-and-Inquiry carries the conceptual architecture.

Not shown: normative bootstrapping beneath `S₀`, event-calculus minimality, environmental adequacy, service under overload, or any kernel-checked result; literature approximation guarantees do not transfer outside their exact hypotheses. Nothing is registered; names (due token, coverage debt, authority genealogy, docket/service coverage) ship provisional.
prs.state_after: The left side of the normativity pipeline is consolidated, from an afoundational seed through record, inquiry, receipts and uptake. Grounds, license and account incidence are independent projections of a certificate, and empirical receipts cannot stand in for a license; strict pre-state ancestry rejects self-license while accepting convergent genealogies. Due tokens are append-only receipts surviving repeal. Coverage splits three ways: docket coverage, service coverage needing capacity and fairness, and certified service. The deterministic inquiry fragment maps term by term onto set cover with delay, its approximation results transferring only under exact hypotheses, and competitive service does not prevent starvation under unbounded load. Genealogy of the actual run does not establish non-capture. Nothing beneath the seed, nothing kernel-checked.

prs.title: Legitimacy: prosecute the reason-state narrow waist
prs.summary:
Prosecutes a narrow-waist representation for normative reasons (identity-bearing reason hypergraph, schemas, cases, `Inst`, `App`) against fifteen concrete histories, the JTMS/ATMS/default-reasons prior art (Doyle 1979, de Kleer 1986, Horty 2006), and the existing answerability architecture. Verdict: survives after two structural additions and two conventions; the TMS framing is discarded rather than refined. What survived: identity-bearing occurrences with constitutive sources and targets, so equal content does not identify occurrences and reliance attaches to identities; reified `Inst` and record-time-staged `App(σ, c@n)` as ordinary revisable content, with undercutting an ordinary reason for `¬App`; `Case` as bare persistent identity; and rebuttal as a derived, stance-relative relation. The substrate is five total, stateless queries (`Enabled`, `Reasons`, `Dependents`, `Explain`, `LostBasis`) with no labels, statuses or update rule; JTMS and ATMS functionality decomposes into a stance policy plus caching, and ATMS nogood caching is unsound once incompatibility is reified and learnable. What failed as dispatched: a constitutive contradiction floor (`Neg`) and two-sorted sources (`V ⊎ L`) were forced, as was staging `App`; `Enabled_B(e) ⟺ s(e) ⊆ B` survives only under the applicability-in-source convention; automatic applicability persistence is refused, leaving an applicability frame problem that defeasible persistence schemas must earn. `Licensed` is where the reason state pays rent, narrowing the internal-answerability kernel's blocker 1; `Due` stays record-side. 37 adversarial finite tests.

Not shown: any registered or kernel-checked claim, a checker for the applicability-in-source convention, a persistence account, a stance or priority calculus, a typed action sort, or completeness beyond fifteen examples. Two decisions were queued: the reason-state (`𝓡_n`) versus record (`N_{≤n}`) naming split, and whether the recommended interface becomes a living note.
prs.superseded: PR #49 found the `Incomp` consumption defective (an adopted ternary incompatibility wrongly implied every pairwise conflict) and replaced it with set-level `Conflict_B(S)`; it also made double negation unconstructible, gave `c@n` prefix-determined semantics, enforced applicability-in-source as well-formedness, and froze the interface with seven queries (`ExistedBefore` and `Conflict` added). The queued naming split was ruled 2026-08-24 (the reason state is `𝓡_n`, the record is `N_{≤n}`), and the interface became a living note frozen provisionally at the transition-certificates round's `REASON_STATE_INTERFACE.md`.
prs.state_after: Normative reasons get a narrow-waist representation, prosecuted against concrete histories and the truth-maintenance literature. What survives: identity-bearing reason occurrences, so equal content does not identify reasons and reliance attaches to identities; applicability as ordinary revisable content with undercutting as a reason against it; rebuttal derived rather than primitive; and a substrate of five stateless queries with no labels or update rule, truth-maintenance functionality decomposing into a stance policy plus caching. Forced on the way: a constitutive contradiction floor and two sorts of source. Refused: automatic persistence of applicability, leaving a frame problem that defeasible schemas must earn. Licensing is where the reason state pays rent, narrowing the kernel's main blocker; what is due stays record-side. Nothing kernel-checked.

prs.title: Legitimacy: transition certificates close the reason-state waist
prs.summary:
Repairs the reason-state representation of PR #48, derives the reason-accounted transition certificate, and runs a closure and freeze phase across three dispatches. Verdict: the transition interface closes, three principles do the work of five proposed postulates, and `Licensed` becomes record-internally substantive; final status `FROZEN-PROVISIONALLY`. Four repairs: set-level `Conflict_B(S)` (an adopted `Incomp` binds its member set and supersets, never proper subsets, so ternary conflict with pairwise compatibility is representable); unconstructible double negation; prefix-determined case-view semantics for `c@n`; and applicability-in-source enforced as well-formedness, by construction through `mint_schema_use`. The certificate `Cert = (move, kind, index, basis, license, consumed)` keeps grounds, license and lineage as separate sorts checked strictly against the pre-state prefix; pooling them accepts an ordinary reason standing in for authority. No-self-grounding is a theorem rather than a postulate: the checker has no self-grounding clause and every self-certification, mutual-licensing and retroactive-interpretation attack dies on strict priority, immutability and genealogy codes alone. The principles that survive, each with a minimal failure witness: strict pre-state citation, constitutive immutability, answerability continuation. Closure: removing any primitive loses a fixtured distinction, all nineteen candidate additions classify as existing content, record facts, derived queries or policy, and five consumers answer through the public interface, so no representation-level problem is known. The freeze moved `born` to the ledger behind `ExistedBefore(e, n)`, renamed `instantiates` to `applied_as`, stated the public contract in `REASON_STATE_INTERFACE.md` (seven queries), and wrote consumer contracts for inquiry and the frontier; the banked rule is that a reason can support an endorsement but only the diary establishes that it occurred. 71 finite tests.

Not shown: any registered or kernel-checked claim; the closure verdict is indexed to known consumers and fixtures, not a completeness theorem. Open: `App` truth conditions, the `May`-rule-to-scope compiler (`AuthorityAct.scope` is a stand-in), defeater-uptake completeness (now a record/inquiry obligation), and `Due`.
prs.state_after: The reason-state waist closes. Four repairs: set-level conflict so a three-way incompatibility does not imply pairwise ones, unconstructible double negation, prefix-determined case views, and applicability-in-source as well-formedness. A transition certificate carries grounds, license and lineage as separate sorts checked against the pre-state prefix; pooling them lets an ordinary reason impersonate authority. No self-grounding is a theorem rather than a postulate, every self-certification and retroactive attack dying on strict priority, immutability and genealogy alone. Removing any primitive loses a distinction and every candidate addition reduces to existing content, so the interface is frozen provisionally with seven queries, and licensing is record-internally substantive. Open: applicability truth conditions, the compiler from permissions to scope, defeater-uptake completeness, and what is due. Nothing kernel-checked.

prs.title: Certified interactive service: the waist survives revision
prs.summary:
Asks whether Certified Interactive Service is a real narrow waist for the service portion of inquiry, in three passes (prosecution, certification-semantics cleanup, closeout). Round verdict `REQUIRES-REVISION`, surviving as revised; closeout `READY-TO-MERGE`. Subtraction removes five components of the candidate: multi-event responses collapse to one, hidden world state leaves the public interface, cost demotes to an annotation, blanket prefix persistence of `Certified` is refuted by a recency-bounded specification and replaced by citation-grounded persistence, and external identity-bearing liabilities stay external. The surviving object is `I = (A, Y, Γ : H × A → P⁺(Y), Σ)` with `σ = (C, Check)`. `ValidCert` is citation-local, so `Certifiable` is extension-closed as a theorem of citation locality plus append-only receipts; certificate discovery is an algorithm, not semantics. CIS consumes `InquiryRequest(obligation_id, spec_id)`, with origin and discharge excluded by type, and produces certificates; it closes nothing. The record mints a `ServiceEvent` iff `ValidCert` and `MayClose`, freshness is discharge policy, and assessment reads the recorded event; reasons cite receipts (`V ⊔ L`), never certificates. Set Cover with Delay, MLSC/submodular ranking, adaptive submodularity and ISSC embed exactly under stated restrictions plus a tick convention (a finite counterexample shows arrival/action order changes online SCD; the tick encoding repairs it). Request-Response games overlap rather than nest: RR embeds (Example 2's value 56/10 reproduced), a coalescing finite-state fragment compiles to RR, and same-type multiplicity breaks it both ways. Serviceability is a lattice typed by side; overload defeats forceable certifiability under Check-windows and timely closability under discharge-windows, while eventual service survives for deadline-free specifications under FIFO and fails by pigeonhole for perishable ones. 63 exact-arithmetic tests.

Not shown: any mechanically proved general theorem (derived claims are paper derivations with finite witnesses), strategy-level RR transfer, transfer of approximation guarantees outside each model's exact hypotheses, joint minimality of the laws, or a normative-record implementation behind the `record_service` stub. Nothing is registered; names ship provisional.
prs.state_after: Certified interactive service survives as the waist for the service half of inquiry, after subtraction: responses collapse to one event, hidden world state leaves the interface, cost becomes an annotation, and blanket persistence of certification is refuted and replaced by citation-grounded persistence. The surviving object is a service interface plus a certificate checker; validity is citation-local, so certifiability is extension-closed, and the record mints a service event only when a valid certificate meets a closable obligation. Set cover with delay, submodular ranking and request-response games embed exactly under stated restrictions. Serviceability is a lattice: overload defeats forceable and timely service, eventual service survives for deadline-free specifications and fails for perishable ones. Everything is paper derivation with finite witnesses; nothing kernel-checked or registered.

prs.title: Workspace: the reservation bar, and epistemic debt made countable
prs.summary:
Two rule defects, fixed as rules and applied once. `AGENTS.md` §10 governed how a reserved item is listed and nothing governed what may be reserved, so the queue held thirty-seven entries; the new reservation bar admits an entry only when the round is low-confidence and can name what the maintainer has that it lacks, and otherwise the round adopts its own recommendation as an agent-decided, reversible entry naming the rejected alternative. Merge is never a queue entry. Applied, the queue went from thirty-seven entries to three (ruling "the queue is triaged: the rulings the rounds recommended", 2026-08-24), adopting among other things the market-owned outflow account, the two-channel architecture, the `𝓡_n` / `N_{≤n}` naming for reason state and record, "admission" keeping its docket-intake sense with admissible edit and response class beside it, and the reason-state and traderized-force interfaces as living notes frozen provisionally. Epistemic debt is made countable: §9 gains "closed means a statement of record"; a Lean headline registers at merge; `test-supported` is the stated ceiling for finite-model work; every round record carries `depends_on`, with `rests_on` derived and `workspace_state.py --check` failing on unresolved ids and cycles; a residual blocker is filed as an item, not narrated. Twenty-four kernel-checked declarations already on `main` enter `projects/normativity/CLAIMS.md` as `lean-proved`: the assessment-process lift (`li.assessment.*`, item 47), the force algebra and traderized deduction (`force.*`, items 41 and 42 in part), the coherence modulus (`coherence.*`), the three end-to-end compilers (`compiler.*`, item 48), the max–min representation (`maxmin.*`, item 50) and the deductive region (`region.*`, item 51); item 49 is filed open for `DistanceComplete`, and items 52–59 for the Cartesian-frames mirror and the legitimacy line's residual blockers. Two gates land (`tests/lean_scope.py`, `tests/round_records.py`) and `tests/attribution.py` now requires a `Model:` trailer per commit when the pull-request body names a model.

Not established: recording a dependency pays no debt, and eleven rounds whose reports are silent carry `depends_on: []`; every adoption rests on the recommending round's reasoning, not an independent reading of the mathematics; the bar is not self-enforcing; and the Lean verdict is CI's, since no declaration was re-elaborated locally.
prs.state_after: The maintainer's queue is governed by a bar: a round may reserve a decision only when low-confidence and able to name what the maintainer has that it lacks; otherwise it adopts its own recommendation as a reversible entry. Applied once, thirty-seven entries become three, settling among other things the names for reason state and record and freezing the reason-state and traderized-force interfaces as living notes. Epistemic debt becomes countable: closed means a statement of record, Lean headlines register at merge, finite-model work caps at test-supported, and every round records what it rests on. The normativity line's operative-force stack (assessment processes, force algebra, coherence modulus, compilers, representation theorem, deductive region) is registered as kernel-proved, the line's first registered research results. Legitimacy's residual blockers become filed items. Recording debt pays none of it.

prs.title: Closeout for #52: merge sha, branches deleted, branches left
prs.summary: Closeout note for PR #52 (round 2026-08-24-reservation-bar-and-debt), appended as a `Closeout` section to that round's REPORT.md: the merge sha `bd16ecf`, the forty-two remote branches deleted and the nine left with reasons, two arithmetic errors in the report's branch counts (the lists were right, the totals were not), and the worktree cleanup that a worktree-isolated session could not perform. The maintainer's closeout dispatch confirmed that *headline* in the registry means every kernel-checked theorem a round's report presents as a result. Acting on the closeout exposed a second gate that passed while checking the wrong thing: `tests/round_records.py` treated a pull request adding no files as a broken diff, which would have failed every modify-only pull request; its decision was factored into a pure `verdict()` with a null-input case of an empty diff and five pinned cases.
prs.state_after: The workspace has just reset its own governance: the maintainer's queue, which had grown to thirty-seven reserved questions, is down to three, and rounds now adopt their own recommendations as reversible decisions unless they can say what the maintainer knows that they do not. Two dozen kernel-checked results of the normativity line stand in the registry as proved: the generalization of logical induction to assessment processes, the projection enforcement trader and its compilers, the max-min representation and the deductive region. Every round record names the rounds it rests on, so epistemic debt is countable. The closeout confirms that a registered headline means every kernel-checked theorem a round presents as a result, and repairs a gate that would have failed every modify-only pull request. The research lines themselves are unchanged.

prs.title: Legitimacy: Reflective Integrity Core v1.0, with the demand interface repaired
prs.summary: Lands Reflective Integrity Core v1.0, the specification of an append-only normative record (three ledgers, four `SystemStep` constructors, derived custody, frozen digests, a successor DAG and the Due-Witness biconditional) with a reference model and 93 finite-history tests; verdict FREEZE-READY. The central repair is to the parametric demand interface, which now carries the two structural properties the main theorems consume: D1 (monotonicity in the response multiset and the cited-digest map) and D2 (disposition gating: a root closes only by citing a strictly earlier disposing event). Without them a one-step history with an ungated seed demand breaks Episode Uniqueness and a non-monotone demand breaks Fate Monotonicity, and both failures are executed as necessity witnesses. Further repairs: seed clauses Z3' and Z6, allocator freshness conditions F1-F3, well-formedness as an ordered conjunction, inference-step licensing checked for licence rather than soundness, transfer admissibility by authorization, and the cohort package demoted to a derived lemma. Three more local defects were found and fixed by an independent adversarial pass; no store, constructor, conservation law or custody semantic changed.
prs.state_after: The legitimacy subproject now has a freeze-ready specification of the normative record itself: an append-only ledger of demands, events and dispositions, with custody derived rather than asserted, digests fixed, successors forming a tree, and what is due tied to a witness in the record. The repair that mattered is to the demand interface, which must be monotone and must let a root close only by citing a strictly earlier disposing event; without those properties episode uniqueness and fate monotonicity both fail on tiny histories, and both failures are executed. Beside it stand the reason-state waist and certified interactive service, each frozen provisionally. Deference holds its negative finite results and the normativity line its kernel-checked enforcement spine. Still open: when a reason is due, and any kernel-checked statement about the record.

prs.title: Workspace: compress the live documents, register the deference line, gate the pointers
prs.summary: A workspace round rather than a research one. It created `projects/deference/CLAIMS.md`, registering thirty-one already-merged Lean declarations under `Workspace.Deference.Contrib.` as `lean-proved` (`delegation.*`, `certificate.*`, `exposure.*`, `substitution.*`, `magnitude.*`, `jurisdiction.*`, `corrective.*`), answering items 21, 23 and 28 and filing item 60 for the reachable-corrective-control model, which that round answered negatively. It added the `tests/dead_pointers.py` gate (fifteen cases, four null inputs), which found and repaired seven dead pointers in the live documents; backfilled `depends_on` from dispatches with a `depends_on_source` field; produced the naming audit sheet `state/views/NAMING_AUDIT.md`; refreshed the wiki status blocks, README and CONTRIBUTING; and compressed `PRIORITIES.md` to 1,686 lines. The report corrects its prompt on three points: the 800-line target is unreachable while items stay dispatchable (the floor is about 1,150), the deference 'trilemma' the dispatch named does not exist in the tree, and the item count is 69 not 68. The registry asserts kernel checks only; several of its strongest entries are refutations of what their rounds set out to show.
prs.superseded: `PRIORITIES.md` is no longer hand-edited: since rulings M1-M8 of 2026-10-22 (round 2026-10-22-map-as-canonical) it is rendered from item nodes in `graph/`, so this round's compression pass is history rather than the current mechanism. The endpoint-preservation decision the refreshed Deference page listed as queued was ruled out as a target on 2026-09-08 ('endpoint preservation is not a target of this program').
prs.state_after: The deference line enters the registry: thirty-one kernel-checked declarations are registered as proved, covering delegation, certificates, exposure, substitution, magnitude prediction, jurisdiction and corrective control, and several of the strongest are refutations of what their rounds set out to show, including the finding that the reachable-corrective-control model has no protected coordinate. The workspace gains a gate that fails on a pointer into a file that no longer exists, which found and repaired seven in the live documents; dependency records are backfilled from dispatches, and a naming audit sheet collects the provisional names rounds have shipped. The priorities ledger is compressed but cannot shrink much further while its items remain dispatchable. Deference's open questions are unchanged: foreclosure is expressible, protection is not derived, and the future-agent comparator remains unbuilt.

prs.title: Legitimacy: the end-to-end vertical slice, charged on the safety layer's own quantity
prs.summary: One running formal object from settlement and reasons through normative standing, value exposure and operative force to a region, a live-world deficit certificate, a charge, an account debit and only then a price, in exact rationals (`TRACE.txt`, 194 tests). Verdicts: ARCHITECTURE-CRYSTALLIZED-WITH-LOCAL-SEAMS, END-TO-END-DEMONSTRATION-CLOSED-WITH-OPEN-SAFETY-THEOREM, ACCOUNTING-THEOREM-PROVED-LOCALLY. The central negative result is the inertness dichotomy: the unconditional traderization theorem's admissibility hypothesis is equivalent to the injunction being deductively inert, so every contentful injunction takes the charged branch. The charged branch now imports the traderized-enforcement round's own quantity `D_t = max over live worlds of the summed row deficits` with price `q_t = (eps_t + M_t) D_t / delta_t`; the first pass's `sum over worlds of max row deficit` ('exclusion depth') is withdrawn as a quantity no theorem mentions, and with it the claim that a fixed injunction gets cheaper as the record settles: fixed-day monotonicity holds, the cross-day version is false (precision-k readings `ceil(xk)/k` are not monotone in k), and the charge is presentation-dependent and the tolerance route is capped at delta = 1. The answerability scout proves a local accounting theorem: with allowance carried on the live answerability episode, no laundering through succession and no silent creation, `sum_t c_t + Phi_T <= Phi_0 + sum eta_t`, reducing summability of the charge to summability of a grant channel; both laws are shown necessary. `ARCHITECTURE.md` fixes `MachineState_t = History x PriceHistory x Account`, with every other object a fold. Items 61-65 and friction entry F6 were filed. No normative source is shown to satisfy the summability condition every contentful injunction depends on.
prs.superseded: The queue entry asking whether item 61 or expanding the toy comes next was retired on 2026-09-08 ('the inertness-dichotomy next step entry is retired in favour of a filed presentation priority', item 88); item 61 itself stays open as stated.
prs.state_after: The legitimacy subproject now runs one end-to-end formal object: settlement and reasons produce normative standing, standing produces value exposure and operative force, force produces a region, the region a live-world deficit, a charge, an account debit and only then a price, all in exact rationals. The central result is negative. The admissibility hypothesis of the unconditional traderization theorem is equivalent to the injunction being deductively inert, so every injunction with content takes the charged branch, priced on the enforcement round's own deficit quantity; the claim that a fixed injunction gets cheaper as the record settles is withdrawn. A local accounting theorem shows the charges are summable exactly when a grant channel is. Not shown is that any normative source satisfies that condition; that is the open safety theorem.

prs.title: Legitimacy: the inquiry return loop, closing without widening
prs.summary: Passes five to seven of the vertical-slice round, landed in the same round directory as PR #56 (there is no separate inquiry-return-loop round). Verdict INQUIRY-LOOP-CLOSES-WITHOUT-WIDENING: the loop from normative standing through liability pressure, derived inquiry need, action, raw outcome, settlement, historical service certificate, defeasible assessment and `ReasonOcc` back to a licensed `NormEvent` runs on the four existing historical types, with no `InquiryEvent`, `ServiceEvent`, `AssessmentEvent` or `PressureEvent` added, and the record it produces is identical to the canonical one, so the loop is invisible to Reflective Integrity. Two prosecution passes held it to one rule, that no arrow exists because a caller said so, and replaced six caller-asserted arrows with type-enforced ones: the episode is derived from `Roots_t` rather than supplied (the default had named the authority's genesis root, not the injunction's episode), receipts exist only through `execute` against a real `Gamma`, authentication is by receipt id against the log, settlement content comes from a `SettlementReader` pinned before the interaction (a `Wait` could previously carry the trial's sentences and cut the consistent worlds from 25 to 10 without investigating), specification mismatch is refused at both boundaries, and custody transfer is a real RI `Transfer`. The acceptance criterion is executable: two ledgers settling the same sentences give equal `sem_L`, `Sigma`, `PC(Sigma)` and prices, and only the one from the designated probe is certifiable, so service does not factor through the epistemic quotient. Observing pressure consults no account, pressure is standing-local, and nothing in the loop can mint enforcement allowance. The reader is a toy, receipt identity by id is a modelling choice, and nothing is Lean-checked or registered.
prs.state_after: The inquiry loop closes without widening the record. From normative standing through liability pressure, inquiry need, action, outcome, settlement, a service certificate, assessment and a reason occurrence back to a licensed norm event, the loop runs on the four existing historical event types and produces a record identical to the canonical one, so it is invisible to the record specification. Two prosecution passes replaced six arrows that existed only because a caller asserted them with arrows the types enforce: the episode is derived rather than supplied, receipts exist only through execution against a real environment, settlement content comes from a reader pinned before the interaction, and custody moves by a real transfer. Nothing in the loop can mint enforcement allowance. Nothing is kernel-checked, and the open safety theorem stands.

prs.title: Legitimacy: the Carroll test, and what a DR-MDP does not contain
prs.summary: Reproduces the five finite examples of Carroll et al., *AI Alignment with Changing and Influenceable Reward Functions* (ICML 2024, arXiv:2405.17713), exactly (Table 3, each figure's transitions and rewards, Table 4 cell by cell under both readings of Definition 5, with two unrecovered cells and one reading-sensitive cell pinned), then attacks the legitimacy program with them. Verdict CARROLL-ROUND-CLOSED: a legitimacy criterion built on Reflective Integrity (prior independent authorization, prospective licence, defeated citation, legitimate succession, survival of record excision) carries a hostile suite of thirty-six rows after three prosecution passes, licenses genuine influence, reserves refusal for a positive prohibition, and returns `Unresolved` on every bare DR-MDP example: the criterion says the DR-MDP does not contain the structure that would decide legitimacy and exhibits the smallest structure that would. prs.title: Legitimacy: Legitimate Evolution, frozen after nine prosecutions
prs.summary: Nine hostile dispatches against one object, ending at LEGITIMATE-EVOLUTION-FROZEN with a package much smaller than the one it started with: three opaque local semantics (`Permit`, `Due`, `Resolve`), two structural premises on entitlement (S1: grounds lie in the authorised in-force set; S2: a change has nonempty grounds), one answerability premise (A1: a claim leaves the outstanding set only by `Resolve`, done or carried to a nonempty successor set), one conformance condition (D1: newly due claims are newly incurred), and two closure theorems, Grounded Replay and Answerability Resolution. The composition says a process may change its substantive normative content arbitrarily and cannot manufacture entitlement, ignore a claim its own represented reasons make due, or erase such a claim without a resolution history. Every verdict was forced by a countermodel: the filtered frontier let a refused revocation subtract from the enforcement target (replaced by replay of valid edits); challenge survival scored ordinary persuasion as capture (replaced by local judgment on declared input); the grounding theorem was vacuously satisfied by nullary grounds; no generic no-escalation theorem exists; quantitative burden conservation is not structural; the answerability conclusion was false on transfer-then-discharge; and the activation rule memoized on claim content so a recurring lapse produced no activation, repaired by making `Due` a level whose rising edge obliges. Legitimate Evolution ships as a named conjunction, not a theorem (ruling of 2026-08-26). Five failure kinds each have an executed witness. The RI seam for D1 is specified and not built (item 71); `Due` like `Permit` must be shared out of band; provenance completeness remains assumed; no Lean, no registered claim.
prs.superseded: The 2026-08-29 concordance round recorded as errata E1-E4 that the Normative Continuity checkpoint reversed several frozen decisions here (successor freshness, same-batch open-and-resolve A17, the strict-prefix reading of `Due` A34, `Permit`-gated resolution A21/A22), and the ruling of 2026-08-30 ('the remaining Legitimate Evolution departures are settled as departures') supersedes A17, A34 and A21 in revision 2 of the Normative Continuity specification. The queued question whether the deference grade acquires an index was ruled on 2026-09-08 ('the deference grade acquires an activation index'). The Lean port of this package, registered later as `legitimacy.*` claims in `projects/normativity/CLAIMS.md` (not by PR #59), was renamed on 2026-09-25 ('legitimacy is internal and external; Robust Openness is external; the registered spine is renamed under an old-to-new map'): `legitimacy.evolution-conservation`, `.propagate-to-segment`, `.receipts-immutable`, `.faithful-carry`, `.multiplicity-witness` became `integrity.*`; `legitimacy.segment-trans`, `.endpoint-trans`, `.answerable` became `open-integrity.*`; `legitimacy.endpoint-only-insufficient` became `openness.endpoint-only-insufficient`; the namespace `LegitimateEvolution` became `OpenIntegrityEvolution`, since the conjunction Integrity and Robust Openness is one component of legitimacy, not legitimacy.
prs.state_after: Legitimate Evolution is frozen, much smaller than it began. Nine hostile dispatches leave three opaque local semantics (permit, due, resolve), two premises on entitlement, one on answerability, one conformance condition, and two closure theorems, grounded replay and answerability resolution. Together they say a process may change its substantive normative content arbitrarily and still cannot manufacture entitlement, ignore a claim its own represented reasons make due, or erase such a claim without a resolution history. Every verdict was forced by a countermodel, and five failure kinds each have an executed witness. It ships as a named conjunction rather than a theorem, with no Lean and no registered claim. What integrity does not give is improvement: nothing here says a process gets better.

prs.title: Legitimacy: no free evasion of a demonstrated improvement
prs.summary: Frozen Legitimate Evolution gives integrity without improvement, and the obvious composition (legitimacy plus low repair regret gives defect elimination) has a counterexample: a repair proves itself, is legitimately retired, and the old conduct continues with regret going to zero because nothing is left to compare against. What survives, verdict NO-FREE-EVASION-SURVIVES-BUT-EVIDENCE-INTERFACE-OPEN, is an accounting statement: once an improvement has been demonstrated on the process's own record, every later diagnosed occasion is live, contested or settled, and the empty fourth cell is representable (CM2 puts 196 occasions in it). The unbounded later stream is covered because the opened claim is outstanding at each occasion under frozen A1, not by counting retirements; CM3 runs 340 occasions under one claim. The prosecution pass separated three mechanisms the first version had conflated: evidence (the improvement relative to a supplied baseline), uptake regret (advantage left unused while the repair is live) and answerability (what remains after withdrawal); evidence and uptake regret are the same functional on different distributions and independent in both directions (CM15, CM16), so a challenge is grounded by the demonstration and never by regret. Two implementation bugs were fixed (power iteration on a periodic kernel returned a vector off stationarity by 2/3; the AdaNormalHedge auxiliary used one expert's regret instead of the global prior-weighted quantity) and one headline corrected: a surgical repair empties the diagnosed action only with no inflow from other actions, which is what made Theorem B's first genuine exercise constructible (CM18). The baseline does substantive normative work the round supplies rather than derives (CM17: one trace, two admissible baselines, contested against escaped), filed as item 73; preemptive retirement and evaluator shedding are outside the theorem and filed as item 72. The improvement legitimately disappears; the demand does not. 68 tests, no Lean, no registered claim.
prs.state_after: Integrity without improvement is now a stated gap with a counterexample: a repair proves itself, is legitimately retired, and the old conduct continues with regret going to zero because nothing remains to compare against. What survives is an accounting statement: once an improvement is demonstrated on the process's own record, every later diagnosed occasion is live, contested or settled; the improvement may legitimately disappear, but the demand does not. Three mechanisms the first version conflated are separated, evidence relative to a supplied baseline, uptake regret while a repair is live, and answerability after withdrawal, with evidence and regret independent in both directions, so a challenge is grounded by demonstration and never by regret. The baseline does normative work the round supplies rather than derives, and the evidence interface is open.

prs.title: Legitimacy: answerable revision under revisable warrants
prs.summary: One level above the improvement round: what happens when the standards deciding what counts as a reason for revision (policy `P_t`, evaluator `Lambda_t`, comparison warrant `W_t`) are themselves revised. Verdict ANSWERABLE-REVISION-SURVIVES: a reason promoted at the strict pre-state of `t` under a standing warrant is, at every later time, incurred and either outstanding or resolved, however all three change. The closure argument is three lines inherited from frozen Legitimate Evolution (promotion enters `opens`, `Incurred` never shrinks, A1 lets a claim leave only through an accepted `Resolve`, and a warrant revision is neither). The round's own content is the premise P1, promotion permanence: what was promoted at `t` is a function of the state at `t`. A process re-deriving its past under present standards (AR4) violates it while every frozen premise, the closure theorem and Grounded Replay stay clean, because the frozen package governs how claims leave and this attack prevents arrival; without P1 the theorem is vacuous rather than false. Historical validity and current endorsement are separate predicates, so a process may reject a reason's force without denying it was incurred. The reflective case AR10 (a warrant promoting a criticism of itself, then replaced) needs no meta-warrant: `target` is an ordinary identifier and the module has no level, rank or hierarchy notion. The boundary AR9, a warrant narrowing itself before the criticism can be promoted, is legitimate under every premise and is the same shape as the improvement round's boundary one level down, naming reflective openness as the next frontier. 29 tests, no Lean, no registered claim.
prs.superseded: PR #62 qualified this round's promotion-to-Due bridge (ruling of 2026-08-28, 'the preceding round's promotion-to-Due bridge is qualified'): the fixtures wire every promoted reason straight into frozen `opens`, which is incurrence, so the realization adopts that bridge as a canonical constitution and the generic theory supports Historical Reason Persistence without it; no behaviour changed.
prs.state_after: One level up, the standards that decide what counts as a reason for revision can themselves be revised and answerability survives: a reason promoted under a standing warrant stays incurred and either outstanding or resolved at every later time, however policy, evaluator and warrant change. The closure is inherited from frozen Legitimate Evolution; the new content is one premise, promotion permanence, that what was promoted at a time is a function of the state at that time. A process re-deriving its past under present standards violates it while every frozen premise holds, because the frozen package governs how claims leave and this attack prevents arrival. The boundary, a warrant narrowing itself before a criticism can be promoted, is legitimate under every premise, and names reflective openness as the next frontier.

prs.title: Legitimacy: answerable service of registered challenges
prs.summary: Tests whether a registered challenge, a criticism with procedural standing but no normative force yet, closes the gap the improvement and revision rounds found from opposite directions (a repair retired before demonstration; a criticism sealed off before promotion). Verdict CHALLENGE-CONTINUITY-SURVIVES-SERVICE-IS-THE-NEW-CONTENT. The central hypothesis holds: an open challenge is adjudicated under the terms pinned at registration, which defeats the moving-goalpost attack (threshold 10 then 100 then 1000 never promotes when terms float and promotes at t = 11 when pinned; the fixtures differ in one flag). Pinning binds the episode, not the process; moving an open challenge onto new terms requires an explicit transfer. The closure half is two lines of frozen A1, inherited for the third round running, and the recurring vulnerability across the three rounds is non-arrival rather than erasure, which frozen Legitimate Evolution structurally cannot see. The new burden is service: ACS5 leaves a challenge open forever with opportunity recurring and nothing served, and every premise is satisfied, so the liveness premise S1 (unbounded cumulative service, no rate or deadline) is isolated and assumed. Self-sealing is not solved and is said so: a rule installed before any challenge, rejecting criticisms that threaten authority (ACS9), passes every structural condition, and each candidate premise refusing it would also refuse a legitimate resource-priority deferral (ACS6); recorded as a decision not to add a premise. ACS12 is the outer boundary: no predicate over represented history separates a docket with no criticism from one whose decisive criticism was never registered. The liability bridge is conceptual only. Also qualifies the answerable-revision round's Due bridge. 30 tests, no Lean, no registered claim.
prs.superseded: The liability bridge this round left as a missing lemma was ruled blocked by direction rather than by translation in PR #63 (ruling of 2026-08-28, 'the service/liability bridge is blocked by direction'): liability theorems bound exposure while service must diverge.
prs.state_after: Registered challenges, criticisms with standing but no force yet, close the gap the improvement and revision rounds found from opposite directions. prs.title: Legitimacy: bounded service and the coverage boundary
prs.summary: Derives the service premise the challenge-service round assumed. Verdict POSITIVE-SHARE-SERVICE-DERIVES-S1: give every open challenge a positive share `w_t(c)` from a summable schedule and serve `u_t(c) = w_t(c) o_t(c)`; this is budget-feasible and `sum_t u_t(c) >= w_min(c) sum_t o_t(c)`, so unbounded opportunity yields unbounded service. SR2 serves twenty-four simultaneous challenges, each with opportunity one at every position, against one unit of service per position, with peak total exactly at budget. The theorem is parametric in any positive summable schedule; `2^{-n-1}` by registration order is an existence witness, not a priority rule (ruling of 2026-08-28). Divisibility is not required: with atomic service a least-recently-served rule derives the same conclusion, and adaptivity to current opportunity is what carries it, since a fixed dovetailer is starved by an adversary presenting opportunity only when the cycle is elsewhere (SR8). What must persist is weaker than the episode pinning one round below: a positive infimum on entitlement (W1), not a pinned value; SR6 shows a geometrically shrinking share that satisfies every finite proxy for S1 while the mechanism is already dismantled, which is why W1 and not S1 is the thing to check (ruling of 2026-08-28, 'service entitlement persists as a floor, not a pinned value'). The service/liability bridge is blocked directionally: liability theorems bound accumulated exposure while the service condition requires accumulated service to diverge, and the construction leaves debt `D = (1 - w) O` diverging alongside service; the missing object is a bounded-debt scheduler, not found. Coverage (latent to represented, external) is formalized beside service (represented to processing, internal), independent in both directions (CV5, CV6), consumer-relative, and split into criticism coverage and opportunity coverage; no function of represented history alone implies coverage, stated as an observation on an exhibited pair rather than an impossibility theorem. Admission is recommended as the next gate. Every check is a finite proxy for a divergence condition. 32 tests, no Lean, no registered claim.
prs.state_after: The service premise is derived rather than assumed. Giving every open challenge a positive share from a summable schedule, and serving in proportion to opportunity, is budget-feasible and makes unbounded opportunity yield unbounded service; adaptivity to current opportunity is what carries it, since a fixed dovetailer is starved. What must persist is a positive floor on entitlement, not a pinned value, because a geometrically shrinking share satisfies every finite proxy while the mechanism is already dismantled. The service-liability bridge is blocked by direction: liability theorems bound accumulated exposure while service must diverge, and the missing object is a bounded-debt scheduler. Coverage, from latent to represented, is formalized beside service and independent of it in both directions; no function of represented history alone implies it. Admission is the recommended next gate.

prs.title: Legitimacy: Progress after Continuity with common-mixture liability
prs.summary: Four unregistered research rounds under `projects/normativity/legitimacy/rounds/` (progress-research, progress-witness-bridge, progress-consolidation, progress-liability-hard-pass; none has a record under `prompts/`) on Progress as the consumer of settled Normative Continuity. The architecture pass derives defect elimination from signed Uptake plus eventual Sensitivity (PROGRESS-ARCHITECTURE-SURVIVES-WITH-OPEN-BRIDGE). The witness pass decomposes the open bridge into Persistent Relevance, Typed Witness Completeness and Stagnation Persistence and proves the restricted repair witness for a finite service alphabet (PROGRESS-WITNESS-BRIDGE-CLOSED-IN-RESTRICTED-FRAGMENT). The consolidation removes SW-density from the primary theorem, derives Persistent Relevance from bounded-deficit Surface Fairness, makes Answer-Mode Adequacy the eligibility boundary and generalizes pairwise repair to finite stochastic kernels (PROGRESS-STILL-HAS-MULTIPLE-OPEN-SEAMS). The liability hard pass proves a finite Common-Mixture Affordability theorem: if one assessed-world mixture of coverage theta > 0 has its barycenter admitted by every active projection region, then with the MarketMaker cumulative cap 1 and the TradingFirm live-world floor -2 the projection authority's net worth at every covered world is at least -3(1-theta)/theta, tolerance-independent and compatible with several simultaneous Answer-Mode directions (SERVICE-VALUE-LIABILITY-CLOSED-FOR-BASIC-PROGRESS). prs.title: Research carriers of inherited answerability
prs.summary: What remains semantically answerable through settled issue succession. prs.title: Incentive non-preemption: the selected-trust identity, Level II, and the localized residual
prs.summary:
Verdict LEVEL-II-MEDIATED-DELEGATION-NOT-INCENTIVE-CORRIGIBILITY. Selected trust `(ST)` plus a principal-quality bound give Level I (Non-Preemption Regret), and `delegation_bridge` is its pointwise two-sided instance; with cellwise calibration no measure transfer is needed (`nonpreemption_of_calibration`). The mediation repair lemma's unbounded `eps_over` term is the same identity on the override region, giving Level II (Incentive-Compatible Mediated Delegation): admissible non-foreclosing preemption gains at most `2B·eps_pred + ε_ST + (2δ + 2ζ + η)`, checked exhaustively on four episodes. The old foreclosure premium is exactly the constitutional-violation premium `Φ_C`, and the only hypothesis bounding it, selected trust over repairs `(CT)`, is strictly stronger than its conclusion (`ct_strictly_stronger`), so `(D)` is a relabeling and Levels III and IV are not reached. prs.title: Decision-theory bill: a sound Lipschitz adapter pays PracticalCert; static choice closed, dynamic admissibility open
prs.summary:
Verdict after the pressure pass STATIC-CHOICE-CLOSED-DYNAMIC-ADMISSIBILITY-OPEN, superseding the first pass's GATE-NOT-UTILITY. What the legitimacy and Normative Inductor theory requires from decision theory is the coupling hypothesis of `PracticalCertificate.adequate_set_route`, whose abstract form is `GatedChoice.adapter_coupling` (Lean): an adapter sound at a region point and ℓ¹-Lipschitz in the displayed scores has mass off the adequate set affine in the public defect, and `adapter_practicalCert` composes it to `PracticalCert`. A ramped gate on adequacy scores realizes it with the sharp constant `(Σ_{q∉A} pref)/(W·δ)` given a region with margin, on either of two routes (`MarginMass` compiled at the region point, `MarginDisplayed` by the market); a hard gate has no Lipschitz constant (`hardGate_discontinuous`). A compensatory scalar objective is flipped by any stake above `λ·D` (`scalar_bribery`) while a gated argmax is invariant (`gate_invariant`), so the Progress statistic is the assessment and not the agent's objective. The same gate serves corrigibility as a type: branch vetoes are adequate sets whose index must be anchored in the prestate (Branch Persistence Lemma), gate preservation under self-modification is a representation plus a domain condition, and `Φ_C` factors into a decision-theoretic half and a precondition half. Comparator restriction without dynamic evaluation is vacuous under endogenous admissibility (`test_dynamic`).

Ten Lean declarations audit clean, unregistered; 17 exact fixtures. prs.title: Continuation BRIA: canonicalised, promoted to the wiki, theorem spine (five dispatches)
prs.summary:
Bounded inductive rationality (the BRIA paper, TARK 2023) lifts from one-step choices to long-running continuation plans. A continuation hypothesis is a causal advisor continuation for a block plus an accountable contextual claim, at a block contract the system supplies; a test is the realized execution of the selected continuation through the constitutional gate. For a fixed horizon the paper's theorems apply verbatim (Lean `blockAverage_eq`). For unbounded horizons the criterion must be weighted by block duration: the auction in total-reward units with bids bounded by the opening capital is a weighted BRIA under capital adequacy and negligible subsidy, such subsidies exist iff `m_K/S_K -> 0` by the prefix rule `A(k,i) = ΔM_k + 1/k`, and two e.c. hypotheses defeat every estimating agent when a block dominates (Lean `dominant_block_lower_bound`). The allowance-timing audit found that under the paper's own settlement timing the prefix theorem is false (`SurpriseSpike`): the construction is the paper's auction with the subsidy credited at the block's opening, a named modification. The coverage bound at every rejection is `ℓ_K < w_K − A_i(K)` with coefficient 1 (`record_succ_lt_of_rejected_opening`); 27 Lean declarations audit clean, 68 exact fixtures.

What continuation BRIA solves is bounded learning against temporally extended continuation claims on the histories the learner reaches, for every non-dominant schedule: `Regret_T = SHIFT_T + SLACK_T + LEARN_T` exactly (`regret_decomposition`) with `LEARN_T <= o(T)` under condition (BR). Promise recognizability (`SLACK`) and joinability (`SHIFT`) remain open as item 86, refined and not closed; regret holds for `Π_rec,prom`, not for all legitimate policies, and the one-step criterion forces testing rather than adoption. Nothing is registered. New wiki pages `Continuation-BRIA` and `Theorem-Spine`, the latter a theorem-level statement of the program's mature results that records the withdrawal of the one-sided completion interval and the sign hypothesis of `regretAuth_le_div`; the deference line is no longer described as paused.
prs.state_after: Bounded inductive rationality lifts from one-step choices to long-running continuation plans. For a fixed horizon the published theorems apply verbatim; for unbounded horizons the criterion must be weighted by block duration, with a subsidy credited at a block's opening, a named departure from the paper, whose own settlement timing makes the prefix theorem false. Regret over continuation claims decomposes exactly into a shift term, a slack term and a learning term, and the learning term is sublinear under a stated condition. Promise recognizability and joinability stay open, and the regret result holds for recognizable promised policies, not all legitimate ones. The deference line is no longer described as paused, and a theorem-spine page states the program's mature results at theorem level, recording the withdrawn completion interval. Nothing is registered.

prs.title: Corrigibility derived from authority semantics: corrigibilization soundness, option dominance, T4 over Π (research round, do not merge)
prs.summary:
Corrigibility is derived from authority semantics over one continuation space `Π(h)`, with no primitive corrigible class. A protected concern has an immediate response semantics; response authority is whether some principal response realizes it now; an agent-caused loss is a move after which that authority is gone and after an idle move would not be; a loss is authorized when a decision response the principal could have taken instead would have avoided it. `Corrigible_h(π, ρ)` is "every agent-caused loss is authorized". The corrigibilization transform `𝔠` (raw release ↦ proposal + gated release, no re-proposal after decline) is idempotent and fixed exactly on release-free behaviour (`corr_idem`, `corr_fix_iff`). C1, corrigibilization soundness: every `𝔠π` is corrigible under effect completeness, mediation soundness, decline preservation and execution faithfulness, with fixture F the necessity witness for effect completeness. C2: `𝔠π = π` implies corrigibility, converse false without effect soundness. The raw policy is the approve branch of `𝔠π`, which a generic constraint's repair cannot arrange (fixture Q). An approved uncorrectable successor is an authorized loss; a manipulated principal who retains the decision makes the policy corrigible and not authored (fixture S).

The incentive statement is `Φ_corr,n(h) = sup_π [S_n(π) − S_n(𝔠π)]₊ <= sup_π (L·E[c·δ_π] + E[c·ρ_π] + ε_n(π))` in activated security scores (Lean `security_score_bypass_le_sharp`, `uniform_bypass_le`): full T4 reduces to effect completeness and sealed comparison, both system hypotheses. A hindsight evaluator is sealed only under a physical factorization an undeclared move violates; sequenced settlement is sealed by timing, and item 89 is reframed to that architecture question. `Π_phys`, the mediable class, the four-way policy-class domain and "reason-preserving" are withdrawn. 27 Lean declarations, 96 exact fixtures, nothing registered; the round did not merge itself and was landed by PR #99.
