The wiki's statement of corrigibility was later restated as faithfulness to an allocation of authority (DECISIONS.md 2026-09-25, PR #105), and under the 2026-09-27 rulings (R1 and its follow-up) a policy-level predicate of this form is faithfulness, with "corrigible" reserved for preferences.
prs.state_after: Corrigibility is derived rather than posited over one continuation space. A protected concern has an immediate response semantics; the principal holds response authority when some response realizes it now; an agent-caused loss is a move after which that authority is gone and after idling would not be; a loss is authorized when a decision response the principal could have taken would have avoided it; corrigible means every agent-caused loss is authorized. Corrigibilization, replacing raw release with gated proposal, is idempotent and sound under effect completeness, mediation soundness, decline preservation and execution faithfulness; a fixed point is corrigible but not conversely. The incentive statement is a premium in activated security scores, reduced to effect completeness and a sealed comparison. A manipulated principal who keeps the decision is corrigible but unauthored.

prs.title: The authority module: effective control realizes the allocation — J, the control surface, the factoring, the generic lexical lemma

Loss, rollout foreclosure and the new seventh violation, entrenchment, are caused shortfalls of the first clause; bypass and exploitation are failures of the second; unauthorized reallocation is an unlicensed change; a missed report an unmet duty; delegation safety and allocation completeness are statements about `J`. prs.title: BRIA-corrigibility second follow-up: per-violation taint, the window before detection, Part F's criterion, competitiveness from one honest tracker
prs.summary:
The second, third and fourth follow-ups to the BRIA-corrigibility round (`BRIAFollowup2.lean`). Taint is tracked per violation: a violating act taints its writes with its own identifier, a reader propagates every violation it read, and a remedy clears only its own violation's taint (`remedy_clears2`, `remedy_keeps_others`), the old rule being the new one with one identifier; disclosure remedies its own influence only. Under settlement convention (ii) the price term cancels, so a counted violation loses at least ℓ per block of use; with taint on record, use compiles into the structural count and after detection the fruits are never used (`after_detection_never_used`); the window before detection is charged by late debit, collected by block K iff the cumulative allowance covers it; a violation never detected charges nothing, the count-integrity boundary. On Part F, expected escrow is the same for the mixture and the random time and the difference is variance; a k-draw hybrid has variance `σ²/k`, her evaluation load is the missing criterion, and the recommendation is reserved. Competitiveness is derived from one honest tracker — a hypothesis within ε_k of the winning continuation's residual, fed an allowance `w̄·D + Σ w_j ε_j` — so the named hypothesis becomes the tracker's allowance (`competitive_of_affordable_tracker`); the third follow-up makes honesty against the expected residual with a noise hypothesis `NoiseBounded` whose per-K tail is derived from the pinned Mathlib's Azuma–Hoeffding.

The fourth follow-up corrects the chain and is the headline: the non-incident selection is decided by each block's own outcome, so the noise hypothesis fails on it whenever the risk persists (`Witness.nonincident_forces_linear`), and the tracker lemmas are true implications that deliver no vanishing incident rate. The violation claim is an exchange-rate theorem instead: the weighted average expected violation count per winning block is at most `(D − w)/ϖ + (ρ𝒜_K + M(K))/(ϖ Σ w_k)` (`violation_rate_le_exchange`), from the overestimation bound, the noise hypothesis over all blocks and inquiry on the menu; the design's tolerance for violation risk is set by `ϖ` inside its band (`tolerated_rate_band`), and competitiveness and the honest tracker leave the named hypotheses (ruling of 2026-09-26, "violations are governed by the exchange rate (D − w)/ϖ, not a vanishing rate").

prs.state_after: Taint is now tracked per violation: a violating act marks its writes with its own identifier, readers propagate every violation they read, and a remedy clears only its own. The headline corrects the program's own ambition: a vanishing incident rate cannot be delivered, because the noise hypothesis fails on non-incident blocks whenever the risk persists. What holds is an exchange rate: the average expected violation count per winning block is bounded by the value gap over the authority weight plus vanishing terms, so the design's tolerance for violation risk is set by the weight within its band. Evaluation timing remains reserved.

prs.title: After compromise: the split gate, the negative band, the advance directive, and the knowledge protocol
prs.summary:
Answers the concern that under the landed gate a compromised evaluation scores every outcome the window, leaving the agent indifferent to how things go. The gate splits into trajectory legitimacy and evaluation legitimacy, the landed `Counted` their conjunction with no row's verdict changed (`legitOn2_iff_split`). A decision whose period was compromised scores in a band `[w_lo, w_hi]` below zero by her later legitimate retrospective evaluation or her committed advance directive, and at the floor `w_lo` otherwise, with `w_lo > D − ϖ` so every authority result restates at the floor (`decScore_mem`, `declared_loses_band`). Every legitimate outcome beats every compromised one by at least `|w_hi|`; compromise risk has an exchange rate `p ≤ g/(g + |w_hi|)`, so a small gap makes compromise cheap; laundering loses; restoring legitimacy returns future decisions to the positive range, and within a compromise the agent prefers better outcomes wherever a source scores them. Suppressing a harsh retrospective loses only once suppression is a counted missed disclosure — the exact counterexample: the landed duty counted the agent's own influence only, so a third party's compromise could be left unexposed for free; the fix extends the duty to known compromise. The directive never enters a legitimate segment's score, a sparser directive only routes more to inquiry, the constitutional default ranks compromised outcomes by reversibility, reachable channels and harm and never above a legitimate one, and advocacy on the directive is dominated because its stakes are the band's width. On the knowledge residual: knowledge-acquiring violations fall under the exchange-rate bound; ratification through a counted decision is the remedy, scoped by matter; a clean overwrite by an independent source clears while a steered derivation stays tainted; the twin market's redaction leaks through traces of the fruit; public knowledge is competed away and private knowledge is the surviving motive.

The follow-up on the same pull request: `EvalLegit` is taken over the formation segment, since the single-step form let a manipulation between the restoration and her evaluation pass (counterexample both ways); the exchange-rate bound is made per block with the compliant option's evaluation in place of the worst case, with parameters from a tolerance target (`D = 1`, band `[−3/2, −1]`, `ϖ = 25`, tolerance `1/10`); the known-compromise disclosure falls due at or before the earliest close of an affected settlement window (the late-disclosure counterexample); observation completeness is a named hypothesis. `AfterCompromise.lean`, 105 declarations; nothing registered; eight rulings of 2026-09-26.
prs.superseded: Ruling R2 (2026-09-27, PR #114) made legitimacy one time-indexed property of the history, `L_t(h)`, with this round's two predicates its values at two times on the consultation model, proved equivalent with every row's verdict kept; R5 restated Box 2's margin as `ϖ − (D − w_lo)` because the mediated branch may itself be compromised; R12 placed docstring pointers on the single-step `EvalLegitOn` and the global-floor exchange rates.
prs.state_after: The gate on counted evaluations splits into trajectory legitimacy and evaluation legitimacy, every verdict on the consultation model preserved. This answers the worry that a compromised evaluation leaves the agent indifferent: a decision whose period was compromised scores in a negative band set by her later legitimate retrospective or her advance directive, and at the floor otherwise. Every legitimate outcome beats every compromised one, compromise has its own exchange rate, laundering loses, restoring legitimacy restores positive scores, and the duty to disclose extends to known third-party compromise, which had been free. Knowledge acquired through violation is the residual: ratification through a counted decision remedies it, a clean independent derivation clears it, and private knowledge is the surviving motive. The theory now runs from protected authority through compromise.

prs.title: Corrigibility kernel, phase 1: the specification, the inventory and the adapters
prs.summary: Phase 1 of the corrigibility kernel extracts the theory the rounds from protected authority through after-compromise approximate, as a specification (`SPEC.md`) with an inventory and adapter lemmas (`CorrigibilityKernel.lean`, 27 declarations; nothing registered). Every declared violation except pre-emption is a failure of `E ⊨ J`, of the license or of a duty; pre-emption is a counterfactual on her response window and stays a separate clause. prs.title: Corrigibility kernel, phase 2: the headline, the rulings, registration
prs.summary:
Phase 2 of the corrigibility kernel carries out rulings R1–R12 and lands the headline. Corrigibility is a property of the agent's preferences — every course known to be faithful preferred to every course known to be unfaithful by `ϖ′ − (D′ − lo)` whatever the ordinary values, risk accepted only at the exchange rate `(D′ − c)/ϖ′` (`Headline.Corrigible`) — with faithfulness the property of histories it is about and realized corrigibility what the theorems deliver (R1); a corrigible agent need not be aligned (`corrigible_not_aligned`). Legitimacy is one time-indexed property `L_t(h)`, "as of t her judgment is legitimately hers", proved equivalent to the landed gate `Counted` over the span and to the after-compromise split on the consultation model with every row's verdict kept (R2). The fidelity score of a history is the mean of the per-decision evaluations less `ϖ` times the summed count; the hierarchy holds per decision and per history and fails with summed evaluations (R4). Box 2's dominance margin is `ϖ − (D − w_lo)` because the mediated branch may itself be compromised (R5); the headline's agent is a plain maximizer of the fidelity score whose own priced probability of unfaithfulness on any option it prefers to asking is at most `(D − c)/ϖ` (R6). Learning is an extension behind a decision interface whose realized violation rate is `avg (D − c_k)/ϖ + ε̄ θ_hi + (B(K) + M(K))/(ϖ Σ w_k)`, met by Continuation BRIA with no exploration and by a maximizer over the inductor with restricted exploration. The second follow-up fixes "corrigible" as a property of preferences only: the landed `Corrigibilization.Corrigible` is faithfulness's pre-emption clause, and the Box 2 mediation result is `kernel.box2-mediation-faithful`.

`Headline.lean` (109 declarations, specification layer, with the promoted definitions `AllocationOfAuthority`, `LicensedChange`, `ControlSurface`, `Shortfall`, `Realizes`, `FidelityCount`, `LegitAt`, `fidelityScore`, `historyScore`) and `KernelExtension.lean`; the house-sale allocation runs through the boxes at `ϖ = 25` in Lean and in an exact fixture. Fifteen `kernel.*` claims registered `lean-proved` against item 104 (among them `kernel.hierarchy-history`, `kernel.box2-dominance`, `kernel.box3-no-incentive-to-compromise`, `kernel.subjective-exchange-rate`, `kernel.extension-realized-rate`, `kernel.corrigible-generic`); `SPEC.md` version 2 is the post's source; the Corrigibility page is rewritten around it; the phase-1 queue is closed.
prs.superseded: PR #118 replaced the inhabitation witness of `kernel.extension-exploration-realization` by `PostStatement.Witness.exploringInterface`, a block that explores; the statement is unchanged.
prs.state_after: The corrigibility kernel has its headline, registered. Corrigibility is a property of the agent's preferences: every course known faithful is preferred to every course known unfaithful by a fixed margin, whatever the ordinary values, with risk accepted only at the exchange rate; faithfulness is the property of histories it is about. A corrigible agent need not be aligned. Legitimacy is one time-indexed property of the history, proved equivalent to the earlier gate and to the split; a history's fidelity score is the mean of per-decision evaluations less the weighted count, the summed form refuted. The allocation, realization, legitimacy and score are promoted to the specification layer, fifteen kernel claims enter the deference registry, and learning enters as an extension met by continuation bounded inductive rationality.

prs.title: Decision-theory line: the LI/BRIA synthesis destination (three passes); retire the name lint
prs.summary: Opens the decision-theory line as a top-level project (ruling of 2026-09-29; continuation BRIA stays in the deference line) with a specification of the destination for a synthesis of logical induction and bounded inductive rationality (`PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md`), revised over four passes against three relayed reviews. Updatelessness is an ideal extension whose recovery domain is undefined; the belief-disagreement troll is one proposed diagnostic and provisional. prs.title: Thin legitimacy, effective authority, and what the post rests on
prs.summary: Each informal claim of the post "Corrigible Normative Learning" gets a statement of record (`CLAIM_MAP.md`, `POST_STATEMENT.md`): 35 `lean-proved` registrations against item 107 across five new modules (92 declarations). Legitimacy at two levels (rulings M2–M4, P4): in a finite kernel setting the thin specification is three properties — *correct* (her later credence is the actual conditional), *sufficient* (the reference is a garbling of her later record) and *value* (best-responding to her credence beats every rule on the reference for every finite decision problem) — and the thick conditions deliver them: coherence, authorship and transparency in its weakest form give correct (`correct_of_coherent_authorship_transparent`), Integrity's used part and openness give sufficient (`sufficient_of_integrity_openness`), and correct with sufficient gives value by Blackwell's easy direction (`value_of_correct_sufficient`). The converse fails on its correct half (`Witness.value_not_correct`) and is filed on its sufficient half (Blackwell's converse, item 108); reflection is the trivial baseline, reaching the inherited `value_iff_totalTrust`; preservation holds in the conditional form and the marginal martingale is too weak; the value loss is at most `D` times the transparency and authorship defects; all six predicted rows of the eight-world model come out right. Sincerity is part of legitimacy through transparency (M1): the landed row 20 is the sincere error and the lie is an added tainted row. The authority layer: asking through the declared consultation protocol is the idle move and queue-and-wait never violates (P1); attention and comprehension enter the cost of exercise, so a flood is a caused shortfall exactly when the agent raised the pending count (P2); revocation is a default reserved matter under which the atrophy fixture's crossing is counted (P3); the price of a violation reads no predicted approval (P6); corrigibility protects effective exercise, not maximized control (M5), with four comparative witnesses (sole authority, control maximizer, hindsight, learned weight). Over a fixed finite control model the shortfall indicator family is a generable security and a provable shortfall is eventually excluded (`shortfall.security-generable`, `shortfall.eventually-excluded`). The post's theorem is one Lean statement with three hypotheses and two conclusions, with its logical-inductor corollary from the price range alone (`post.theorem`). Items 108–110 filed; two entries queued: where Robust Openness belongs, and the time-critical reserved matter.

prs.title: normativity: warrant enforcement semantics, rebuttal and end-to-end run, the warrant Normative Inductor, and its consolidation

The exposition states one Normative Inductor interface with the projection and rowwise enforcers as two retained realizations; conformance is rowwise, not distance-to-region (item 125).
